定理 20.name: 定理 20
定理 20.content: 设 {z^k} 是由满足准则 (L) 的变度量近端点算法生成的任意序列。假设算子 T^{-1} 在原点处可微，且 T^{-1}(0) = {\bar{z}}，∇T^{-1}(0) = J。如果 lim_k || D_k(z^k)|| = 0，则 {z^k} 超线性收敛到解 \bar{z} 当且仅当 (32) 式成立：\frac {\left[ I - \left(I + \frac {1}{c _ {k}} J\right) H _ {k} ^ {- 1} \right]\left(z ^ {k + 1} - z ^ {k}\right)}{\left\| z ^ {k + 1} - z ^ {k} \right\|} \rightarrow 0 \quad \text {as } k \rightarrow \infty .
定理 20.proof_text: 设 \tilde{z}^{k + 1} := \mathcal{N}_k(z^k) = (I + H_k D_k)(z^k)。由命题 3 (a) 有 \tilde{z}^{k + 1} = z^k - H_k(I + T^{-1}\frac{1}{c_k})^{-1}(z^k)。因此 z^k \in (I + T^{-1} \frac{1}{c_k}) [ H_k^{-1} (z^k - \tilde{z}^{k+1}) ] = H_k^{-1}(z^k - \tilde{z}^{k+1}) + T^{-1}[ \frac{1}{c_k} H_k^{-1}(z^k - \tilde{z}^{k+1}) ]，等价地，z^{k+1} - \bar{z} = z^k - \bar{z} + (z^{k+1} - z^k) \in [ T^{-1}(\frac{1}{c_k} H_k^{-1}(z^k - \tilde{z}^{k+1})) - \bar{z} + (z^{k+1} - z^k) + H_k^{-1}(z^k - \tilde{z}^{k+1}) = \left[ T^{-1}(\frac{1}{c_k} H_k^{-1}(z^k - \tilde{z}^{k+1})) - \bar{z} - J(\frac{1}{c_k} H_k^{-1}(z^k - \tilde{z}^{k+1})) \right] + [ I - (I + \frac{1}{c_k} J) H_k^{-1} ] (z^{k+1} - z^k) + (I + \frac{1}{c_k} J) H_k^{-1} (z^{k+1} - \tilde{z}^{k+1}) = \left[ T^{-1}(\frac{-1}{c_k} D_k(z^k)) - \bar{z} - J(\frac{-1}{c_k} D_k(z^k)) \right] + [ I - (I + \frac{1}{c_k} J) H_k^{-1} ] (z^{k+1} - z^k) + \left(I + \frac{1}{c_k} J\right) H_k^{-1} \left(z^{k+1} - \tilde{z}^{k+1}\right). 由引理 21，右边第一项和第三项可被 o(||z^k - \bar{z}||)\mathbb{B} 界住。若 (32) 成立，则 [I - (I + \frac{1}{c_k} J)H_k^{-1}](z^{k+1} - z^k) \in o(||z^{k+1} - z^k||)\mathbb{B}。因此存在趋于零的正序列 {\alpha_{1k}} 和 {\alpha_{2k}}，使得对 k > \bar{k}_1，有 ||z^{k+1} - \bar{z}|| \leq \alpha_{1k} ||z^{k+1} - z^k|| + \alpha_{2k} ||z^k - \bar{z}|| \leq \alpha_{1k} (||z^k - \bar{z}|| + ||z^{k+1} - \bar{z}||) + \alpha_{2k} ||z^k - \bar{z}|| = \alpha_{1k} ||z^{k+1} - \bar{z}|| + (\alpha_{1k} + \alpha_{2k}) ||z^k - \bar{z}||。取 \bar{k}_2 > \bar{k}_1 使得对所有 k > \bar{k}_2 有 \alpha_{1k} < 1/2，记 \tau_k = (\alpha_{1k} + \alpha_{2k})/(1 - \alpha_{1k})，则 ||z^{k+1} - \bar{z}|| \leq \tau_k ||z^k - \bar{z}||，且 \tau_k \to 0，故 {z^k} 超线性收敛。反之，假设 (36) 成立。将 (35) 除以 ||z^k - \bar{z}|| 并令 k \to \infty，由 (36) 和引理 21 得 [I - (I + \frac{1}{c_k} J) H_k^{-1}](z^{k+1} - z^k)/||z^k - \bar{z}|| \to 0。由 (36) 有 ||z^k - \bar{z}||/||z^{k+1} - z^k|| \leq 1/(1 - ||z^{k+1} - \bar{z}||/||z^k - \bar{z}||) \to 1，故 (32) 成立。

引理 21.name: 引理 21
引理 21.content: 在定理 20 的条件下，对所有充分大的 k，有 (a) T^{-1}(\frac{-1}{c_k} D_k(z^k)) - \bar{z} - J(\frac{-1}{c_k} D_k(z^k)) \subset o(||z^k - \bar{z}||)\mathbb{B}，和 (b) (I + \frac{1}{c_k} J)H_k^{-1}(z^{k+1} - \mathcal{N}_k(z^k)) \in o(||z^k - \bar{z}||)\mathbb{B}。
引理 21.proof_text: 对于 (a)，取 δ > 0 使得当 ||w|| < δ 时 T^{-1}(w) - Jw - \bar{z} \subset o(||w||)\mathbb{B}。取 \bar{k}_1 使得当 k > \bar{k}_1 时 ||D_k(z^k)|| \leq δ。则由 (33) 和命题 3 (c)，当 k > \bar{k}_1 时，T^{-1}(\frac{-1}{c_k} D_k(z^k)) - \bar{z} - J(\frac{-1}{c_k} D_k(z^k)) \subset o(||D_k(z^k)||)\mathbb{B} \subset o(||z^k - \bar{z}||)\mathbb{B}。对于 (b)，注意到 \mathcal{N}_k(z^k) = (I + H_kD_k)(z^k)，由准则 (L) 有 ||(I + \frac{1}{c_k} J) H_k^{-1} (z^{k+1} - \mathcal{N}_k(z^k))|| = ||(I + \frac{1}{c_k} J)(w^k - D_k(z^k))|| \leq (1 + ||J||) ||w^k - D_k(z^k)|| \leq δ_k (1 + ||J||) ||w^k|| \leq \frac{δ_k (1 + ||J||)}{1 - δ_k} ||D_k(z^k)||。因此由 (34) 和命题 3 (c)，(I + \frac{1}{c_k} J) H_k^{-1} (z^{k+1} - \mathcal{N}_k(z^k)) \in o(||D_k(z^k)||)\mathbb{B} \subset o(||z^k - \bar{z}||)\mathbb{B}。

线性收敛性定理.name: 线性收敛性定理
线性收敛性定理.content: 如果假设 $T^{-1}$ 在原点处是 Lipschitz 连续的，则该方法线性收敛。

定理17.name: 定理17
定理17.content: 当集合 $T^{-1}(0)$ 被假设为有界时，该结果的一个修订版本。

非线性耗散动力系统.name: 非线性耗散动力系统
非线性耗散动力系统.content: 设 H 是一个实希尔伯特空间，Φ: H → R 是一个连续可微函数，其梯度在有界集上利普希茨连续。研究非线性耗散动力系统：ẍ(t) + λẋ(t) + ∇Φ(x(t)) = 0，λ > 0，加上柯西数据。

收敛到临界点的新结果.name: 收敛到临界点的新结果
收敛到临界点的新结果.content: 在多种情况下，包括当 Φ 是凸函数（可能具有多个最小值）或 Φ 是莫尔斯函数（此时临界点通常是局部最小值）时，给出了关于解收敛到临界点的新结果。

轨迹可能不收敛的反例.name: 轨迹可能不收敛的反例
轨迹可能不收敛的反例.content: 一个反例表明，在没有特殊假设的情况下，轨迹可能不收敛。

探索局部最小值的方法.name: 探索局部最小值的方法
探索局部最小值的方法.content: 通过跟踪轨迹，获得了一种探索 Φ 的局部最小值的方法。

奇异摄动分析.name: 奇异摄动分析
奇异摄动分析.content: 奇异摄动分析将我们的结果与梯度系统的结果联系起来。

HBF系统全局存在唯一性定理.name: HBF系统全局存在唯一性定理
HBF系统全局存在唯一性定理.content: 假设Φ下有界，且∇Φ在有界集上Lipschitz连续，则(HBF)动力系统存在全局唯一解。

HBF系统渐近收敛定理（Morse函数）.name: HBF系统渐近收敛定理（Morse函数）
HBF系统渐近收敛定理（Morse函数）.content: 当Φ是Morse函数且HBF轨迹预紧时，轨迹在t→+∞时渐近收敛。

HBF系统弱收敛定理（凸函数）.name: HBF系统弱收敛定理（凸函数）
HBF系统弱收敛定理（凸函数）.content: 当Φ是凸函数且argminΦ非空时，HBF系统的轨迹在t→+∞时在H中弱收敛。

HBF_ε到SD的收敛定理（有限区间）.name: HBF_ε到SD的收敛定理（有限区间）
HBF_ε到SD的收敛定理（有限区间）.content: 当ε→0时，(HBF)_ε系统的轨迹在任意有界区间[0,T]上一致收敛到(SD)系统的对应轨迹。

HBF_ε到SD的收敛定理（无穷区间）.name: HBF_ε到SD的收敛定理（无穷区间）
HBF_ε到SD的收敛定理（无穷区间）.content: 当Φ是凸函数时，随着ε→0，轨迹在[0,+∞)上一致收敛。

SD系统.name: SD系统
SD系统.content: 最速下降法（连续梯度法）：ẋ(t) + ∇Φ(x(t)) = 0。

接触条件.name: 接触条件
接触条件.content:
粒子 M 与表面 Σ 保持接触的条件是：
g + \dot{x} H_\Phi \dot{x} > 0
其中 H_\Phi 是 Φ 的 Hessian 矩阵。
接触条件.proof_text: 由反应力的表达式 R = m(g + \dot{x} H_\Phi \dot{x}) / \sqrt{1 + |\nabla \Phi(x)|^2} 和条件 R > 0 直接推导得出。

运动方程.name: 运动方程
运动方程.content:
粒子在曲面 Σ = Graph(Φ) 上运动的方程为：
m \ddot{x} + \lambda_f \dot{x} + (m/(1 + |\nabla \Phi(x)|^2))(g + \dot{x} H_\Phi(x) \dot{x}) \nabla \Phi(x) = 0
运动方程.proof_text: 从动力学基本方程 (2.1) 出发，代入重力、粘性摩擦力和约束反力的表达式，通过投影和消去反力 R 得到。

动力学基本方程.name: 动力学基本方程
动力学基本方程.content: 粒子 M 的运动由方程 m \ddot{r} = \vec{G} + \vec{F} + \vec{R} 控制，其中 \vec{G} 是重力，\vec{F} 是粘性摩擦力，\vec{R} 是曲面的约束反力。

假设 (H).name: 假设 (H)
假设 (H).content: Φ: H → R 满足：(1) Φ在H上连续可微；(2) Φ在H上有下界；(3) ∇Φ在H的有界子集上Lipschitz连续。

推论 3.1.name: 推论 3.1
推论 3.1.content: 假设Φ: H → R满足假设(H)且λ > 0。进一步假设Φ是强制的，即lim_{|x|→+∞} Φ(x)=+∞，则x ∈ L^∞(0,+∞; H)且定理3.1的结论成立。
推论 3.1.proof_text: 由不等式(3.5)得Φ(x(t)) ≤ Φ(x₀) + (1/(2g))|ẋ₀|²，结合Φ的强制性得x有界。

ω-极限集定义.name: ω-极限集定义
ω-极限集定义.content: 对于给定的初始条件 y0=(x0,ẋ0)∈H×H，令 x_y0(.) 表示方程 (3.1): ẍ(t) + λẋ(t) + ∇Φ(x(t)) = 0 的唯一最大解。轨迹 x_y0 的 ω-极限集 ω_y0 定义为 ω_y0 = ∩_{t>0} 闭包{x_y0([t,+∞[)}。ω_y0 也可以表示为 x_y0(.) 当 t→+∞ 时的极限点集合：ω_y0 = {ξ∈H: ∃(t_n)_n∈N, t_n→+∞ 且 x(t_n)→ξ}。

临界点集定义.name: 临界点集定义
临界点集定义.content: Φ 的临界点集合记为 S = {x∈H: ∇Φ(x)=0}。

Morse 函数定义.name: Morse 函数定义
Morse 函数定义.content: Φ:H→R 是一个 Morse 函数，如果 Φ∈C^2 且其 Hessian H_Φ(ẋ) 在每个临界点 ẋ 处具有连续逆。所有 Morse 函数的临界点都是孤立的。

定理 4.3.name: 定理 4.3
定理 4.3.content: 当 Φ 是凸函数且 argmin Φ ≠ ∅ 时，HBF 轨迹弱收敛。

Opial 引理.name: Opial 引理
Opial 引理.content: 设 H 是 Hilbert 空间，x: [0, +∞[ → H 是一个函数，存在非空集合 S ⊂ H 满足：(i) 对任意 tₙ → +∞，若 x(tₙ) ⇀ x̄ 弱收敛于 H，则 x̄ ∈ S。(ii) 对任意 z ∈ S，lim_{t→+∞} |x(t) - z| 存在。则当 t → +∞ 时，x(t) 弱收敛到 S 中的某个元素 x̄。
Opial 引理.proof_text: Opial 引理的证明并不复杂。只需注意由 (ii) 知轨迹 x(·) 有界。设 x(tₙ) ⇀ z₁ 和 x(tₘ) ⇀ z₂ 是轨迹的两个弱极限点，证明必有 z₁ = z₂。由 (i)，z₁ 和 z₂ 属于 S，由 (ii) 知 lim_{t→+∞} |x(t) - z₁|² 和 lim_{t→+∞} |x(t) - z₂|² 存在。因此 lim_{t→+∞} (|x(t) - z₁|² - |x(t) - z₂|²) 存在，化简得 lim_{t→+∞} ⟨x(t), z₂ - z₁⟩ 存在。于是 lim_{tₙ→+∞} ⟨x(tₙ), z₂ - z₁⟩ = lim_{tₘ→+∞} ⟨x(tₘ), z₂ - z₁⟩，即 ⟨z₁, z₂ - z₁⟩ = ⟨z₂, z₂ - z₁⟩。等价于 |z₂ - z₁|² = 0，即 z₂ = z₁。

引理 4.2.name: 引理 4.2
引理 4.2.content: 设 h ∈ C¹(0, +∞; R⁺) 满足微分不等式 ḧ(t) + λḣ(t) ≤ g(t)，其中 g ∈ L¹(0, +∞; R⁺)。则 (ḣ)₊（ḣ 的正部）属于 L¹(0, +∞; R)，且作为推论，lim_{t→+∞} h(t) 存在。
引理 4.2.proof_text: 令 f(t) = ḣ(t)，有 ḟ(t) + λf(t) ≤ g(t)。两边乘以 e^{λt} 并在 (0,t) 上积分得 f(t) ≤ e^{-λt} f(0) + e^{-λt} ∫₀ᵗ e^{λs} g(s) ds。由函数 r → r₊ = max(r,0) 的递增性，f₊(t) ≤ e^{-λt} f(0)₊ + e^{-λt} ∫₀ᵗ e^{λs} g(s) ds。由 Fubini 定理，∫₀^{+∞} e^{-λt} dt ∫₀ᵗ e^{λs} g(s) ds = (1/λ) ∫₀^{+∞} g(s) ds < +∞，故 f₊(t) = (ḣ(t))₊ ∈ L¹(0, +∞)。为证 h(t) 收敛，对任意 0 < s < t < +∞，h(t) - h(s) = ∫ₛᵗ ḣ(τ) dτ ≤ ∫ₛᵗ (ḣ)₊(τ) dτ。因此 h(t) - ∫₀ᵗ (ḣ)₊(τ) dτ ≤ h(s) - ∫₀ˢ (ḣ)₊(τ) dτ，即 d(t) = h(t) - ∫₀ᵗ (ḣ)₊(τ) dτ 是递减函数。由于 h ≥ 0 且 (ḣ)₊ ∈ L¹，d 有下界，故 lim_{t→∞} d(t) 存在，从而 lim_{t→+∞} h(t) = lim_{t→+∞} d(t) + ∫₀^{+∞} (ḣ)₊(τ) dτ 也存在。

反例构造.name: 反例构造
反例构造.content: 存在一个 C^1、强制、梯度在有界集上 Lipschitz 连续的函数 Φ: R^2 → R，使得 (HBF) 系统 (4.6) 存在一个解 t ↦ x(t) 当 t → +∞ 时不收敛。
反例构造.proof_text: 构造过程如下：首先构造一个不收敛的有界轨迹 x(t) = (1 + 1/log t) (cos(log t), sin(log t))，然后通过逆问题方法，利用 (4.9) 和 (4.11) 在螺旋线上定义 Φ 和 ∇Φ，再通过 Hermite 插值将 Φ 扩展到整个 R^2，并验证其满足所需的正则性。

等价条件.name: 等价条件
等价条件.content: 若函数 Φ 在螺旋线 S 上满足 (4.12) 和 (4.13)，则 x(t) 是 (HBF) 系统 (4.6) 的解。

定理 5.2.name: 定理 5.2
定理 5.2.content:
假设 Φ : H → R 是凸的，C¹，下方有界，且 ∇Φ 在有界集上 Lipschitz 连续。对于任意 Cauchy 数据 x₀ ∈ H, ẋ₀ ∈ H 及任意 ε > 0，令 x_ε 是 εẍ_ε + ẋ_ε + ∇Φ(x_ε) = 0, x_ε(0) = x₀, ẋ_ε(0) = ẋ₀ 的解。
a) 当 ε → 0 时，序列 (x_ε) 在 [0,+∞[ 上一致收敛到 (SD) 系统 ẋ + ∇Φ(x) = 0, x(0) = x₀ 的唯一解 x。此外，存在常数 C ∈ R⁺ 使得 ||x_ε - x||_{L^∞(0,+∞;H)} ≤ C√ε。
b) 假设 argmin Φ ≠ ∅ 并设 x_ε(∞) = w-lim_{t→+∞} x_ε(t)；则：b1) x(∞) = w-lim_{t→+∞} x(t) 存在；b2) x_ε(∞) → x(∞) 在 H 中强收敛当 ε → 0；b3) ẋ_ε → ẋ 在 L²(0,+∞;H) 中当 ε → 0。
定理 5.2.proof_text:
a) 由 ∇Φ 的单调性得 ⟨-εẍ_ε - ẋ_ε + ẋ, x_ε - x⟩ ≥ 0，即 1/2 d/dt |x_ε - x|² + ε⟨ẍ_ε, x_ε - x⟩ ≤ 0。积分并分部积分得 1/2 |x_ε(t)-x(t)|² + ε⟨x_ε(t)-x(t), ẋ_ε(t)⟩ ≤ ε∫₀ᵗ ⟨ẋ_ε(s)-ẋ(s), ẋ_ε(s)⟩ ds。由能量估计得 |εẋ_ε(t)| ≤ C√ε 和 ∫₀^∞ |ẋ_ε(t)|² dt ≤ C，且 ẋ ∈ L²(0,+∞;H)。故 ∫₀ᵗ ⟨ẋ_ε-ẋ, ẋ_ε⟩ ds ≤ C。因此 1/2 |x_ε(t)-x(t)|² ≤ C√ε |x_ε(t)-x(t)| + Cε，从而 ||x_ε - x||_{L^∞} ≤ C√ε。
b) 由定理 4.3，对任意 ε>0，w-lim_{t→+∞} x_ε(t) = x_ε(∞) 存在且 x_ε(∞) ∈ argmin Φ。对任意 z∈H, s,t>0，⟨x(t)-x(s),z⟩ = ⟨x(t)-x_ε(t),z⟩ + ⟨x_ε(t)-x_ε(s),z⟩ + ⟨x_ε(s)-x(s),z⟩。由 (5.21) 得 |⟨x(t)-x(s),z⟩| ≤ 2C√ε|z| + ⟨x_ε(t)-x_ε(s),z⟩。由于 x_ε(t) 弱极限存在，limsup_{s,t→∞} |⟨x(t)-x(s),z⟩| ≤ 2C√ε|z|，对任意 ε>0 成立，故 lim_{t→∞} ⟨x(t),z⟩ 存在，即 w-lim x(t)=x(∞) 存在，证得 b1。
由 (5.21) 得 |x_ε(t)-x(t)| ≤ C√ε，令 t→∞ 得 |x_ε(∞)-x(∞)| ≤ C√ε，故 x_ε(∞) → x(∞) 强收敛，证得 b2。
由能量估计 (5.6) 令 t→∞ 得 Φ(x_ε(∞)) + ∫₀^∞ |ẋ_ε(s)|² ds ≤ ε/2 |ẋ₀|² + Φ(x₀)。取上极限得 limsup [Φ(x_ε(∞)) + ∫₀^∞ |ẋ_ε|² ds] ≤ Φ(x₀)。由 (SD) 得 Φ(x(t)) + ∫₀ᵗ |ẋ(s)|² ds = Φ(x₀)，且 lim_{t→∞} Φ(x(t)) = Φ(x(∞))，故 Φ(x₀) = Φ(x(∞)) + ∫₀^∞ |ẋ(s)|² ds。由于 Φ(x_ε(∞)) = Φ(x(∞)) = min Φ，得 limsup ∫₀^∞ |ẋ_ε|² ds ≤ ∫₀^∞ |ẋ|² ds。结合弱收敛得 ẋ_ε → ẋ 在 L²(0,+∞;H) 中强收敛，证得 b3。
定理 5.2.chapter_id: 2000-Attouch-Goudou_Redont-Heavy_ball_friction_continuous_dynamical.correction.md::5 The steepest descent as a limit case of the heavy ball with friction

一维二次HBF轨迹公式.name: 一维二次HBF轨迹公式
一维二次HBF轨迹公式.content: 对于一维二次函数 Φ(x)=½ax² (a>0)，HBF轨迹由以下公式给出：1. 若 λ² > 4a，则 x(t) = α e^{-½(λ+ω)t} + β e^{-½(λ-ω)t}；2. 若 λ² < 4a，则 x(t) = α e^{-½(λ+iω)t} + β e^{-½(λ-iω)t}；3. 若 λ² = 4a，则 x(t) = (αt + β)e^{-½λt}，其中 ω = √|λ² - 4a|，α和β是由a、λ及初始位置和速度决定的常数。

一维二次HBF收敛速率.name: 一维二次HBF收敛速率
一维二次HBF收敛速率.content: 对于一维二次函数 Φ(x)=½ax² (a>0)，x(t) 向最小值0的收敛速率分别为：当 λ² > 4a 时为 O(e^{-½(λ-ω)t})，当 λ² < 4a 时为 O(e^{-½λt})，当 λ² = 4a 时为 O(te^{-½λt})。

二维二次HBF方程分解.name: 二维二次HBF方程分解
二维二次HBF方程分解.content: 对于二维二次函数 Φ(x,y)=½(ax²+by²) 且 a<<b，其HBF方程可分解为两个独立的标量HBF方程：ẍ + λẋ + a x = 0 和 ÿ + λẏ + b y = 0。

HBF方法收敛性质.name: HBF方法收敛性质
HBF方法收敛性质.content: 无论初始条件和摩擦系数λ如何，球最终静止于一个临界点x∞，该点通常是局部极小值。

BFGS proximal method.name: BFGS proximal method
BFGS proximal method.content: A globally and superlinearly convergent BFGS proximal method is obtained.

近端映射的定义.name: 近端映射的定义
近端映射的定义.content: 给定 x ∈ ℝ^N 和对称正定 N×N 矩阵 M，f 被扰动为强凸函数 φ_M(z) := f(z) + (1/2)⟨M(z - x), z - x⟩；⟨u, v⟩ := u^T v 是 ℝ^N 中的通常点积，|·| 是相关范数。x 在近端映射下的像是 p_M(x) := arg min{φ_M(z): z ∈ ℝ^N}。

Moreau–Yosida正则化的定义.name: Moreau–Yosida正则化的定义
Moreau–Yosida正则化的定义.content: f 的 Moreau–Yosida 正则化是函数 f^p，其在 x ∈ ℝ^N 处的值为 f^p(x) := φ_M(x^p) = min{f(z) + (1/2)⟨M(z - x), z - x⟩: z ∈ ℝ^N}。

Moreau–Yosida正则化的性质.name: Moreau–Yosida正则化的性质
Moreau–Yosida正则化的性质.content: f 的最小值与 f^p 的最小值重合，且 f^p 是凸的、处处有限且相当光滑：在没有额外假设的情况下，f^p 具有 Lipschitz 连续的梯度，由公式 ∇f^p(x) = M(x - x^p) = g^p 给出。

Algorithmic Pattern 1 (AP1).name: Algorithmic Pattern 1 (AP1)
Algorithmic Pattern 1 (AP1).content: Step 0: The symmetric positive definite matrix M is fixed throughout, say M = I. Start with an initial x1 and some matrix M1. Set the iteration counter n = 1. Step 1: Given xn, generate a sequence p_n^k → p_M(x_n), for example by a bundling algorithm, until the associated stopping criterion is satisfied. Step 2: Compute a stepsize t_n > 0 to obtain x_{n+1} := x_n - t_n M_n^{-1} M (x_n - p_n^k). Step 3: Update M_n by a quasi-Newton formula using (1.8). Increase n by 1 and loop to Step 1.

Remark 1.1.name: Remark 1.1
Remark 1.1.content: Incidentally, a second question is the choice of M: after all, the best matrix for (1.1)-(1.3) should be M = 0, in which case no update of x_n would be needed. Among other things, M should somewhat take into account the scaling of the problem.

定理 2.3.name: 定理 2.3
定理 2.3.content: Assume that the closed convex function f has a nonempty bounded set of minima, and let {x_n} be a sequence generated by (GAP). Then {x_n} is bounded, and if ∑_{n=1}^∞ λ_min(W_n) = ∞, any accumulation point of {x_n} minimizes f. The same properties hold for the sequence of proximal points {x_n^p} and it also holds lim inf |g_n^p| = 0.
定理 2.3.proof_text: Our starting assumption implies that the level sets of f are bounded (see [30], Theorems 8.4 and 8.7 and [13], Proposition IV.3.2.5); the sequences {x_n} and {x_n^p} are therefore bounded by construction. In what follows, f̄ will denote the minimal value of f. Combining (2.8) and (2.9), we have 1/2 ⟨W_n g_n^p, g_n^p⟩ ≤ 1/m (f(x_n) - f(x_{n+1})), which gives by summation ∑_{n=1}^∞ ⟨W_n g_n^p, g_n^p⟩ ≤ 2/m (f(x_1) - f̄) < ∞ and therefore ∑_{n=1}^∞ λ_min(W_n) |g_n^p|^2 < ∞. In view of (2.14), the sequence {|g_n^p|^2} cannot be bounded away from 0: there exists a subset N_1 ⊂ ℕ such that lim_{n∈N_1} g_n^p = 0. Extract from N_1 a further subset, say N_2 ⊂ N_1, such that {x_n^p}_{n∈N_2} tends to some limit x̄. Because of (2.3), the closedness of the subdifferential mapping implies that 0 ∈ ∂f(x̄): x̄ minimizes f and f(x̄) = f̄. Now {f(x_n)} is non-increasing and has a limit f^*; also ⟨W_n g_n^p, g_n^p⟩ → 0 in view of (2.15). Pass to the limit in (2.9), written for n∈N_2; we obtain f^* ≤ f^* - m(f^* - f̄), which implies f^* = f̄. Then any accumulation point of {x_n} is also optimal.

拟牛顿方程.name: 拟牛顿方程
拟牛顿方程.content: 对称正定矩阵 M_n 通过满足拟牛顿方程 M_{n+1} s_n = y_n 进行更新，其中 s_n := x_{n+1} - x_n, y_n := g_{n+1} - g_n。

正齐次算子.name: 正齐次算子
正齐次算子.content: An operator H from R^N to R^N is positively homogeneous when H(tv) = tHv, for all v in R^N and all t >= 0.

有界正齐次算子.name: 有界正齐次算子
有界正齐次算子.content: A positively homogeneous operator H is said bounded if |H| := sup_{|v|=1} |Hv| is finite. It is equivalent to say that H is continuous at 0.

局部Lipschitz梯度假设.name: 局部Lipschitz梯度假设
局部Lipschitz梯度假设.content: The gradient g is locally Lipschitzian around x̄: there is a constant L_g such that for all x, y in Ω, |g(x) - g(y)| ≤ L_g |x - y|.

方向导数定义.name: 方向导数定义
方向导数定义.content: g admits at x̄ a directional derivative g'(x̄, d), for all d in R^N. The mapping d ↦ g'(x̄, d) is denoted by H̄, i.e., H̄ d := H̄(d) = lim_{t↓0} (g(x̄ + td) - g(x̄))/t. H̄ is positively homogeneous by definition and bounded because of (3.6): |H̄| ≤ L_g.

强方向导数假设.name: 强方向导数假设
强方向导数假设.content: The directional derivative (3.7) exists in a strong sense at x̄: lim_{(x,y)→(x̄,x̄), x≠y} (g(x) - g(y) - H̄(x - y))/|x - y| = 0.

特定速率收敛假设.name: 特定速率收敛假设
特定速率收敛假设.content: For some positive constant L and all x, y in Ω, |g(x) - g(y) - H̄(x - y)| ≤ L(|x - x̄| + |y - x̄|)|x - y|.

引理 3.3.name: 引理 3.3
引理 3.3.content: Suppose that (3.6), (3.7) and (3.12) hold. Then, for all r > r̄/(2 - r̄), there exist positive constants ε̂₁, ε̂₂ and μ such that if one iterate (xₙ, Mₙ) of Algorithm (qN-AP3) satisfies |xₙ - x̄| ≤ ε̂₁ and |Mₙ - M̄| ≤ ε̂₂, then Mₙ is positive definite with |Mₙ⁻¹| ≤ μ and the next iterate xₙ₊₁ satisfies |xₙ₊₁ - x̄| ≤ r|xₙ - x̄|.
引理 3.3.proof_text: Let r > r̄/(2 - r̄); there exists r' > r̄ such that r = r'/(2 - r'): just take r' := 2r/(1 + r). Now, choose ε̂₂ > 0 so that ε̂₂ < 1/|M̄⁻¹| and ε̂₂|M̄⁻¹||H̄|(1/|M̄⁻¹| - ε̂₂)⁻¹ ≤ (r' - r̄)/2, and set μ := (1/|M̄⁻¹| - ε̂₂)⁻¹. By the first inequality of (3.15), μ is a positive constant. Now, because g(x̄) = 0, we have in (3.10) g(x) - H̄(x - x̄) = o(|x - x̄|). Therefore, there exists ε₁ > 0 such that |x - x̄| ≤ ε₁ ⇒ |g(x) - H̄(x - x̄)| ≤ (r' - r̄)/(2μ)|x - x̄|. Then, define ε̂₁ > 0 by ε̂₁ := ε₁/(μ^{1/2}(|M̄| + ε̂₂)^{1/2}). Having determined the positive constants ε̂₁, ε̂₂ and μ, we now prove the conclusions of the lemma, assuming (3.13). First, by (3.13) and (3.15), we have |Mₙ - M̄| ≤ ε̂₂ < 1/|M̄⁻¹|. Then, the identity Mₙ = M̄[I + M̄⁻¹(Mₙ - M̄)] and the Banach perturbation lemma imply that Mₙ is non-singular (in fact positive definite) and that |Mₙ⁻¹| ≤ μ, with μ defined in (3.16). Next, we observe that xₙ₊₁ = xₙ - 2Mₙ⁻¹gₙᵖ = xₙᵖ - Mₙ⁻¹gₙᵖ. Thus an easy calculation gives eₙ₊₁ = eₙᵖ - Mₙ⁻¹gₙᵖ = (I - Mₙ⁻¹H̄)eₙᵖ - Mₙ⁻¹(gₙᵖ - H̄eₙᵖ) = (I - M̄⁻¹H̄)eₙᵖ + M̄⁻¹(Mₙ - M̄)Mₙ⁻¹H̄eₙᵖ - Mₙ⁻¹(gₙᵖ - H̄eₙᵖ). We are going to bound the norm of the right-hand side of (3.19) by a multiple of |eₙᵖ|. There is no difficulty with the first two terms. For the last term we shall use the implication (3.17) after having shown that |eₙᵖ| ≤ ε₁. To do this, observe that Lemma 2.1(iv) with y = x̄ gives (1/|Mₙ⁻¹|)|eₙᵖ|² ≤ |Mₙ||eₙ|². Hence, using (3.13), |eₙ| ≤ ε̂₁ and (3.18), we get |eₙᵖ| ≤ |Mₙ⁻¹|^{1/2}|Mₙ|^{1/2}|eₙ| ≤ μ^{1/2}(|M̄| + ε̂₂)^{1/2}ε̂₁ = ε₁. Now, using (3.12) and (3.17), (3.19) gives |eₙ₊₁| ≤ (r̄ + |M̄⁻¹|ε̂₂μ|H̄| + μ(r' - r̄)/(2μ))|eₙᵖ| ≤ r'|eₙᵖ|, where we used the second inequality of (3.15) and (3.16). Finally, by (3.5), |eₙᵖ| ≤ (|eₙ| + |eₙ₊₁|)/2, and the last inequality becomes (1 - r'/2)|eₙ₊₁| ≤ (r'/2)|eₙ|. The conclusion of the lemma follows from the definition of r': |eₙ₊₁| ≤ (r'/(2 - r'))|eₙ| = r|eₙ|. □

有界退化假设 (BDA).name: 有界退化假设 (BDA)
有界退化假设 (BDA).content: Let there exist a positive constant C_BD, a symmetric positive definite matrix M̄ and a neighbourhood U = Ω_x × Ω_M of (x̄, M̄), with Ω_M containing only non-singular matrices, with the following property. If (xₙ, Mₙ) is in U, if (xₙ₊₁, Mₙ₊₁) is generated by Algorithm (qN-AP3) from (xₙ, Mₙ) and if xₙ₊₁ is also in Ω_x, then ||Mₙ₊₁ - M̄|| ≤ (1 + C_BD σₙ)||Mₙ - M̄|| + C_BD σₙ, where the matrix norm ||·|| satisfies (3.20) and σₙ is defined by (3.3).

定理 3.4.name: 定理 3.4
定理 3.4.content: Suppose that (3.6), (3.7) and (3.12) hold and that the update of the matrices in Algorithm (qN-AP3) satisfies (BDA) with the same matrix M̄ as in (3.12). Then, for all r ∈ ]r̄/(2 - r̄), 1[, there exist positive constants ε₁ and ε₂, such that |x₁ - x̄| ≤ ε₁ and |M₁ - M̄| ≤ ε₂ imply the following statements: (i) Algorithm (qN-AP3) is well defined in the sense that, for all n ≥ 1, Mₙ is positive definite and xₙᵖ and xₙ lie in Ω_x. (ii) The sequences {Mₙ} and {Mₙ⁻¹} are bounded and the sequence {||Mₙ - M̄||} converges. (iii) The sequence {xₙ} converges linearly to x̄ at rate r: |xₙ₊₁ - x̄| ≤ r|xₙ - x̄|, ∀ n ≥ 1.
定理 3.4.proof_text: Take r ∈ ]r̄/(2 - r̄), 1[ ≠ φ and let ε̂₁ > 0 and ε̂₂ > 0 be given by Lemma 3.3. Then choose ε₂ > 0 such that B(M̄, 2ηε₂) ⊂ Ω_M and 2η²ε₂ ≤ ε̂₂; here η is defined in (3.20), Ω_M is introduced in (BDA) and B(·,·) refers to ||·||. Next, choose ε₁ > 0 such that B(x̄, ε₁) ⊂ Ω_x, ε₁ ≤ ε̂₁ and 2C_BD ε₁ (2ηε₂ + 1)(1/(1 - r)) ≤ ηε₂, where Ω_x and C_BD were introduced in (BDA). The positive constants ε₁ and ε₂ being determined, suppose that (3.22) holds and let us prove by induction that for all n ≥ 1: ||Mₙ - M̄|| ≤ 2ηε₂, |xₙ₊₁ - x̄| ≤ r|xₙ - x̄|. First, by (3.20), ||M₁ - M̄|| ≤ η|M₁ - M̄| ≤ ηε₂. Therefore, (3.26) is satisfied for n = 1. As ε₁ ≤ ε̂₁ and ε₂ ≤ ε̂₂ (by (3.24) and η ≥ 1), we have |x₁ - x̄| ≤ ε̂₁ and |M₁ - M̄| ≤ ε̂₂. By Lemma 3.3, this implies that the next iterate x₂ is well defined and that (3.27) holds for n = 1. Now, assume for induction that (3.26) and (3.27) are satisfied for n=1,…,m-1. By (3.27), (3.22) and (3.25), the points x₁,…,xₘ are in B(x̄,ε₁)⊂Ω_x, and by (3.26) and (3.24), the matrices M₁,…,Mₘ₋₁ are in B(M̄,2ηε₂)⊂Ω_M. Therefore, we can use (BDA) for n=1,…,m-1 to obtain: ||Mₙ₊₁ - M̄|| - ||Mₙ - M̄|| ≤ C_BD σₙ (||Mₙ - M̄|| + 1) ≤ 2C_BD |xₙ - x̄| (||Mₙ - M̄|| + 1) ≤ 2C_BD r^{n-1} ε₁ (2ηε₂ + 1), where we have used (3.22), (3.26) and (3.27). Adding up from 1 to m-1 and using (3.28) and (3.25), we get ||Mₘ - M̄|| ≤ ||M₁ - M̄|| + 2C_BD ε₁ (2ηε₂ + 1)(1/(1 - r)) ≤ 2ηε₂. This proves (3.26) for n = m. To get (3.27) for n = m, we use as before Lemma 3.3 after having observed that |xₙ - x̄| ≤ ε̂₁ (by (3.27) and (3.22)) and |Mₙ - M̄| ≤ ε̂₂ (by (3.26) and (3.24)). This completes our induction argument. The boundedness of {Mₙ⁻¹} is given by Lemma 3.3. Finally, the proof of the convergence of {||Mₙ-M̄||} follows a classical scheme. The sequence {Mₙ} being bounded, the sequence {||Mₙ-M̄||} has limit points. Then, we proceed by contradiction, supposing that there are two limit points: l₁<l₂. As the series ∑_{n=1}^{∞}σₙ converges, there is an index n₀ such that ∑_{n=n₀}^{∞}σₙ ≤ (l₂ - l₁)/3 C_BD^{-1} (2ηε₂ + 1)^{-1}. We can also choose an index n₁ ≥ n₀ such that ||M_{n₁} - M̄|| ≤ l₁ + (l₂ - l₁)/3. Then, using (BDA) and (3.26), we can write, for all n ≥ n₁, ||Mₙ - M̄|| ≤ ||M_{n₁} - M̄|| + C_BD ∑_{i=n₁}^{n-1} (σ_i (||M_i - M̄|| + 1)) ≤ ||M_{n₁} - M̄|| + C_BD (2ηε₂ + 1) ∑_{i=n₀}^{∞}σ_i ≤ ||M_{n₁} - M̄|| + (l₂ - l₁)/3 ≤ l₂ - (l₂ - l₁)/3, contradicting the fact that l₂ is another limit point.

引理 3.5.name: 引理 3.5
引理 3.5.content: Let H: ℝ^N ↦ ℝ^N be positively homogeneous, continuous and injective. Then the following properties hold: (i) there exists a constant C_H such that |Hu| ≥ C_H|u| for all u ∈ ℝ^N, (ii) for any two bounded sequences {u_n} and {v_n} in ℝ^N, Hu_n - Hv_n → 0 ⇒ u_n - v_n → 0, (iii) if u_n → 0 then H(u_n + o(|u_n|)) = Hu_n + o(|u_n|).
引理 3.5.proof_text: (i) Let C_H := min_{|u| = 1} |Hu| ≥ 0 ; by continuity there exists u_0 of norm 1 such that |Hu_0| = C_H. Then the injectivity of H implies C_H > 0 ; the conclusion follows from positive homogeneity. (ii) Having an arbitrary cluster point w of {u_n - v_n}, extract a subsequence such that u_n → u, v_n → v and u_n - v_n → w = u - v. By continuity, Hu_n → Hu, Hv_n → Hv and by assumption, Hu = Hv. Since H is injective, u = v, w = 0 ; the result follows. (iii) If H is continuous, it is uniformly continuous on the ball B(0,2) ⊂ ℝ^N. When u_n ≠ 0, u_n/|u_n| + o(1) ∈ B(0,2) for large n. Hence, by uniform continuity, H(u_n/|u_n| + o(1)) = H(u_n/|u_n|) + o(1). Thanks to positive homogeneity, we have proved (3.29).

定理 3.6.name: 定理 3.6
定理 3.6.content: Let {x_n} be a sequence generated by the recursion formula (3.2) converging to a solution point x̄. Suppose that (3.6), (3.7) hold and that H̄ is continuous and injective. Then x_n → x̄ q-superlinearly ⇔ (M_n - H̄)(-s_n) = o(|s_n|).
定理 3.6.proof_text: First, remembering that s_n = -2M_n^{-1}g_n^p, we have, due to (3.10), M_n s_n = -2g_n^p = -2H̄ e_n^p + o(|e_n^p|). Hence, (M_n - H̄)(-s_n) = 2H̄ e_n^p - H̄(-s_n) + o(|e_n^p|). Let us prove the ‘⇒’ part. As e_{n+1} = o(|e_n|), we have 2e_n^p = e_{n+1} + e_n = e_n + o(|e_n|), -s_n = -e_{n+1} + e_n = e_n + o(|e_n|). The last estimate also implies that e_n = O(|s_n|). Combining these estimates with (3.31) and using (3.29) with H = H̄, we get (M_n - H̄)(-s_n) = o(|e_n|) = o(|s_n|). Consider now the ‘←’ part. From (3.31), H̄(-s_n) + o(|s_n|) = H̄(2e_n^p) + o(|e_n^p|). Taking norms and applying Lemma 3.5(i), we get C_H|s_n| ≤ |H̄(-s_n)| ≤ |H̄(2e_n^p)| + o(|e_n^p|) + o(|s_n|). Using the boundedness of H̄ we conclude |s_n| = O(|e_n^p|). On the other hand, after division of (3.32) by |e_n^p|: o(|e_n^p|)/|e_n^p| + o(|s_n|)/|e_n^p| = H̄(2e_n^p)/|e_n^p| - H̄(-s_n)/|e_n^p|. Thanks to (3.33), the left-hand side tends to 0. We are in a position to apply Lemma 3.5(ii) with u_n = 2e_n^p/|e_n^p| and v_n = -s_n/|e_n^p|. Thus (2e_n^p + s_n)/|e_n^p| = 2e_{n+1}/|e_n^p| → 0, which can be written e_{n+1} = o(|e_n^p|) = o(|e_{n+1} + e_n|) = o(|e_{n+1}|) + o(|e_n|). This implies e_{n+1} = o(|e_n|) and the q-superlinear convergence of {x_n}.

推论 3.7.name: 推论 3.7
推论 3.7.content: Let {x_n} be a sequence generated by Algorithm (qN-AP3) converging to a solution point x̄. Suppose that (3.6)-(3.8) hold and that H̄ is invertible. Then x_n → x̄ q-superlinearly ⇔ (M_{n+1} - M_n)s_n = o(|s_n|).
推论 3.7.proof_text: Due to the quasi-Newton equation (3.1), the second statement in (3.34) is equivalent to y_n - M_n s_n = o(|s_n|). Apply (3.8) with x = x_{n+1}, y = x_n : we have y_n = H̄ s_n + o(|s_n|) ; since (3.8) also implies the linearity of H̄, the conclusion follows from Theorem 3.6.

局部可比范数定义.name: 局部可比范数定义
局部可比范数定义.content: 设 |·|_n 是一个 Hilbert 矩阵范数（例如加权 Frobenius 范数），通常 |·|_n 依赖于 x_n 和 x_{n+1}。若存在 σ_LC > 0 和 C_LC > 0，使得对所有 σ_n ≤ σ_LC 和所有 M ∈ R^{N×N}，有 ||M|_n - ||M||| ≤ C_LC ||M|| σ_n，则称范数 |·|_n 局部可比于固定范数 ||·||。
局部可比范数定义.chapter_id: 1995-Bonnans-Variable_Metric_Proximal_Point.correction.md::3.4. Superlinear convergence of variational quasi-Newton algorithms

变分拟牛顿公式定义.name: 变分拟牛顿公式定义
变分拟牛顿公式定义.content: 设 K 是一个对称矩阵的闭凸集，当 σ_n 很小时与集合 {M ∈ R^{N×N}: M s_n = y_n} 相交。变分拟牛顿公式是指一种方法，它将当前矩阵 M_n 关联到（对称）更新 M_{n+1} := qN(M_n, y_n, s_n)，该更新是 min_M {|M - M_n|_n^2: M ∈ K, M s_n = y_n} 的唯一解。
变分拟牛顿公式定义.chapter_id: 1995-Bonnans-Variable_Metric_Proximal_Point.correction.md::3.4. Superlinear convergence of variational quasi-Newton algorithms

技术假设定义.name: 技术假设定义
技术假设定义.content: 存在一个对称正定矩阵 \(\bar{M} \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times N}\)，存在 σ_TEX > 0 和 C_TEX > 0，使得对所有 σ_n ≤ σ_TEX，存在 \(\hat{M}_n \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times N}\)，满足 \(\hat{M}_n \in \mathscr{K}\)，\(\hat{M}_n s_n = y_n\)，且 \(|\hat{M}_n - \bar{M}|_n \leq C_{\mathrm{TEX}} \sigma_n\)。
技术假设定义.chapter_id: 1995-Bonnans-Variable_Metric_Proximal_Point.correction.md::3.4. Superlinear convergence of variational quasi-Newton algorithms

引理 3.8.name: 引理 3.8
引理 3.8.content: 假设算法 (qN-AP3) 按照方案 (3.36) 更新矩阵 M_n，并且条件 (3.35) 和 (3.37) 成立。则假设 (BDA) 成立，其中 \(\bar{M}\) 由 (3.37) 给出。
引理 3.8.proof_text: 令 σ := min(σ_LC, σ_TEX, 1/(3C_LC))。由于 M_{n+1} 是 M_n 到包含 \(\hat{M}_n\) 的闭凸集上的正交投影，我们有 |M_n - M_{n+1}|_n^2 + |M_{n+1} - \hat{M}_n|_n^2 ≤ |M_n - \hat{M}_n|_n^2。特别地，|M_{n+1} - \hat{M}_n|_n ≤ |M_n - \hat{M}_n|_n。我们证明 (BDA) 以 C_BD := 3 max(C_LC, C_TEX) 和 (3.37) 给出的 \(\bar{M}\) 成立，当 σ_n ≤ σ 时。利用 (3.39) 和 (3.37)，我们有 |M_{n+1} - \bar{M}|_n ≤ |M_{n+1} - \hat{M}_n|_n + |\hat{M}_n - \bar{M}|_n ≤ |M_n - \hat{M}_n|_n + C_TEX σ_n ≤ |M_n - \bar{M}|_n + 2 C_TEX σ_n。然后，利用 (3.35)，我们得到 (1 - C_LC σ_n) ||M_{n+1} - \bar{M}|| ≤ (1 + C_LC σ_n) ||M_n - \bar{M}|| + 2 C_TEX σ_n，即 ||M_{n+1} - \bar{M}|| ≤ ((1 + C_LC σ_n)/(1 - C_LC σ_n)) ||M_n - \bar{M}|| + (2 C_TEX/(1 - C_LC σ_n)) σ_n。由于 σ_n ≤ σ ≤ 1/(3C_LC)，有 (1 + C_LC σ_n)/(1 - C_LC σ_n) ≤ 1 + 3 C_LC σ_n 和 2 C_TEX/(1 - C_LC σ_n) ≤ 3 C_TEX。因此 ||M_{n+1} - \bar{M}|| ≤ (1 + 3 C_LC σ_n) ||M_n - \bar{M}|| + 3 C_TEX σ_n，这正是 (BDA) 类型的有限退化性质。
引理 3.8.chapter_id: 1995-Bonnans-Variable_Metric_Proximal_Point.correction.md::3.4. Superlinear convergence of variational quasi-Newton algorithms

定理 3.9.name: 定理 3.9
定理 3.9.content: 假设 (3.6)、(3.7) 和 (3.12) 成立。假设算法 (qN-AP3) 按照方案 (3.36) 更新矩阵 M_n，并且条件 (3.35) 和 (3.37) 成立，后者中的 \(\bar{M}\) 与 (3.12) 中的相同。那么，如果 (x_1, M_1) 足够接近 (\bar{x}, \bar{M})，算法 (qN-AP3) 是良定义的，并生成一个 q-线性收敛到 \bar{x} 的序列 {x_n} 和一个对称正定矩阵序列 {M_n}，使得 (M_{n+1} - M_n) → 0。
定理 3.9.proof_text: 根据引理 3.8，(BDA) 与 (3.12) 中的相同矩阵 \(\bar{M}\) 成立。然后，定理 3.4 给出了结果的第一部分（序列 {x_n} 的线性收敛），以及 ||M_n - \bar{M}|| → δ。剩下要证明 (3.40)。由于 {x_n} 到 \bar{x} 的线性收敛，我们可以假设对所有 n ≥ 1，σ_n ≤ min(σ_LC, σ_TEX)。如同引理 3.8 的证明，我们有不等式 |M_n - M_{n+1}|_n^2 + |M_{n+1} - \hat{M}_n|_n^2 ≤ |M_n - \hat{M}_n|_n^2，并且我们继续证明 |M_{n+1} - \hat{M}_n|_n 和 |M_n - \hat{M}_n|_n 都趋于 δ。从 (3.35)，(3.41) 意味着 |M_n - \bar{M}|_n → δ 和 |M_{n+1} - \bar{M}|_n → δ。利用 (3.37)，我们得到 ||M_n - \hat{M}_n|_n - |M_n - \bar{M}|_n| ≤ |\hat{M}_n - \bar{M}|_n → 0，以及 ||M_{n+1} - \hat{M}_n|_n - |M_{n+1} - \bar{M}|_n| ≤ |\hat{M}_n - \bar{M}|_n → 0。由此和 (3.43)，我们推断 |M_n - \hat{M}_n|_n → δ 和 |M_{n+1} - \hat{M}_n|_n → δ。然后，(3.42) 意味着 |M_{n+1} - M_n|_n → 0，并且由 (3.35)，||M_{n+1} - M_n|| → 0。
定理 3.9.chapter_id: 1995-Bonnans-Variable_Metric_Proximal_Point.correction.md::3.4. Superlinear convergence of variational quasi-Newton algorithms

定理 3.10.name: 定理 3.10
定理 3.10.content: 假设 (3.6)-(3.8) 成立且 \(\bar{H}\) 是正定的。假设算法 (qN-AP3) 按照方案 (3.36) 更新矩阵 M_n，并且条件 (3.35) 和 (3.37) 成立，后者中的 \(\bar{M} = \bar{H}\)。那么，如果 (x_1, M_1) 足够接近 (\bar{x}, \bar{H})，算法 (qN-AP3) 是良定义的，并生成一个 q-超线性收敛到 \bar{x} 的序列 {x_n}。
定理 3.10.proof_text: 假设 (3.8) 意味着 \(\tilde{H}\) 是线性的，因此 (3.12) 以 \(\tilde{M} = \tilde{H}\) 成立；然后我们可以应用定理 3.9，它给出了序列 {x_n} 的 q-线性收敛和 (M_{n+1} - M_n) → 0。现在 {x_n} 的 q-超线性收敛由推论 3.7 得出。
定理 3.10.chapter_id: 1995-Bonnans-Variable_Metric_Proximal_Point.correction.md::3.4. Superlinear convergence of variational quasi-Newton algorithms

PSB update formula.name: PSB update formula
PSB update formula.content: M_{n+1} = PSB(M_n, y_n, s_n), where PSB(M, y, s) := M + ((y - M s) s^T + s (y - M s)^T) / |s|^2 - (⟨y - M s, s⟩ / |s|^4) s s^T.

DFP formula.name: DFP formula
DFP formula.content: DFP(M, y, s) := M + ((y - M s) y^T + y (y - M s)^T) / ⟨y, s⟩ - (⟨y - M s, s⟩ / ⟨y, s⟩^2) y y^T.

Weighted Frobenius norm.name: Weighted Frobenius norm
Weighted Frobenius norm.content: For a symmetric positive definite matrix W, the weighted Frobenius norm is defined as M ↦ |M|_{W,F} := |W^{-1/2} M W^{-1/2}|_F.

BFGS更新矩阵的迹公式.name: BFGS更新矩阵的迹公式
BFGS更新矩阵的迹公式.content: 矩阵 M_+ = BFGS(M, y, s) 的迹由下式给出：tr M_+ = tr M - |M s|^2 / ⟨M s, s⟩ + |y|^2 / ⟨y, s⟩。

BFGS-proximal方法的超线性收敛定理.name: BFGS-proximal方法的超线性收敛定理
BFGS-proximal方法的超线性收敛定理.content: 给定任意初始对 (x_1, M_1)，其中 M_1 对称正定，生成的序列 {x_n} 超线性收敛到问题 (1.1) 的解。

BFGS-proximal方法的超线性收敛定理（第二个）.name: BFGS-proximal方法的超线性收敛定理（第二个）
BFGS-proximal方法的超线性收敛定理（第二个）.content: 给定任意初始对 (x_1, M_1)，其中 M_1 对称正定，生成的序列 {x_n} 超线性收敛到问题 (1.1) 的解。

BFGS-proximal algorithm (BFGS-AP3).name: BFGS-proximal algorithm (BFGS-AP3)
BFGS-proximal algorithm (BFGS-AP3).content: Step 0. Choose an initial point x1 ∈ ℝ^N and an initial symmetric positive definite matrix M1. Take m in ]0, 1[. Set n = 1. Step 1. Given xn and Mn, compute x_n^p := p_{M_n}(x_n) and set s_n^p := x_n^p - x_n. Step 2. Compute the next iterate by: x_{n+1} := x_n + t_n s_n^p. The stepsize t_n ≥ 1 is chosen to satisfy the general descent condition (2.9) and ⟨y_n, s_n⟩ > 0, where s_n = x_{n+1} - x_n and y_n = g_{n+1} - g_n. We also suppose that t_n = 2 is taken when the line-search conditions (2.9) and (4.3) allow it. Step 3. Update Mn by the BFGS formula: M_{n+1} = BFGS(M_n, y_n, s_n). Increase n by 1 and loop to Step 1.

线搜索可行性引理.name: 线搜索可行性引理
线搜索可行性引理.content: Feasibility of this line-search is easy to establish. First of all, the requirement t ≥ 1 is not classical but x_n^p, obtained for t = 1, satisfies the descent test (2.9) with a strict inequality. Then, by convexity of f, the stepsizes that satisfy (2.9) form a closed interval, say S1, containing 1 in its interior. As for (4.3), remark that the function 0 ≤ t ↦ ⟨g(x_n + t s_n^p) - g_n, s_n^p⟩ =: d(t) is non-negative and non-decreasing and cannot be identically zero when f is bounded below in the direction s_n^p. This implies that the stepsizes satisfying (4.3) form an open interval I2 = ]t^a, +∞[, with finite t^a. We have to show that I1 and I2 intersect. There are 2 cases: 1. If t^a < 1, I1 ∩ I2 contains some neighbourhood of 1. 2. If 1 ≤ t^a < +∞, the key is to observe that f(x_n + t s_n^p) has the constant slope ⟨g_n^p, s_n^p⟩ = -⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩ at any t ∈ [0, t^a] (recall (2.2)). Hence ⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩ = f(x_n) - f(x_n^p) ≥ δ_n. Then, since t^a ≥ 1 > m, we can write f(x_n + t^a s_n^p) = f(x_n) - t^a ⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩ < f(x_n) - m δ_n. Thus, there is ε > 0 such that any stepsize in ]t^a, t^a + ε] satisfies (2.9) and (4.3).
线搜索可行性引理.proof_text: First of all, the requirement t ≥ 1 is not classical but x_n^p, obtained for t = 1, satisfies the descent test (2.9) with a strict inequality. Then, by convexity of f, the stepsizes that satisfy (2.9) form a closed interval, say S1, containing 1 in its interior. As for (4.3), remark that the function 0 ≤ t ↦ ⟨g(x_n + t s_n^p) - g_n, s_n^p⟩ =: d(t) is non-negative and non-decreasing and cannot be identically zero when f is bounded below in the direction s_n^p. This implies that the stepsizes satisfying (4.3) form an open interval I2 = ]t^a, +∞[, with finite t^a. We have to show that I1 and I2 intersect. There are 2 cases: 1. If t^a < 1, I1 ∩ I2 contains some neighbourhood of 1. 2. If 1 ≤ t^a < +∞, the key is to observe that f(x_n + t s_n^p) has the constant slope ⟨g_n^p, s_n^p⟩ = -⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩ at any t ∈ [0, t^a] (recall (2.2)). Hence ⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩ = f(x_n) - f(x_n^p) ≥ δ_n. Then, since t^a ≥ 1 > m, we can write f(x_n + t^a s_n^p) = f(x_n) - t^a ⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩ < f(x_n) - m δ_n. Thus, there is ε > 0 such that any stepsize in ]t^a, t^a + ε] satisfies (2.9) and (4.3).

引理 4.3.name: 引理 4.3
引理 4.3.content: Assume that the convex function f is differentiable. With x̄ minimizing f, let α > 0 and x ∈ ℝ^N satisfy f(x) ≥ f(x̄) + α|x - x̄|^2. Then f(x) ≤ f(x̄) + (1/α)|g(x)|^2.
引理 4.3.proof_text: Write the subgradient inequality at x and obtain with the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality f(x) ≤ f(x̄) + |g(x)||x̄ - x|, so that with (4.4) and the non-negativity of f(x) - f(x̄), f(x) - f(x̄) ≤ |g(x)|√([f(x) - f(x̄)]/α). The result follows.

引理 4.4.name: 引理 4.4
引理 4.4.content: Let {M_n} be generated by the BFGS formula using pairs of vectors (y_n, s_n) satisfying ⟨y_n, s_n⟩ ≥ α_1|s_n|^2 and ⟨y_n, s_n⟩ ≥ α_2|y_n|^2 for all n ≥ 1, where α_1 > 0 and α_2 > 0 are independent of n. Then for any r ∈ ]0, 1[, there exist positive constants γ_1 and γ_2, such that cos θ_j ≥ γ_1, |M_j s_j|/|s_j| ≤ γ_2, for at least [rn] indices j in {1, …, n}.

定理 4.5.name: 定理 4.5
定理 4.5.content: Assume that {x_n} converges to a minimum point x̄, in the neighbourhood of which f is strongly convex and has a Lipschitz continuous gradient mapping. Then the convergence of {x_n} is r-linear; this implies in particular that ∑_{n≥1}|x_n - x̄| < ∞.
定理 4.5.proof_text: Since this is an asymptotic statement, we limit our attention to large enough n in all the proof below. The Lipschitz property of g ensures the second condition in (4.6) (see again [25]). The first one, as well as the growth condition (4.4), are ensured by strong convexity (i.e., strong monotonicity of the gradient mapping). Then our proof is based on an over-estimation of f(x_n) - f(x̄) and begins by over-estimating f^p(x_n) - f(x̄). Inequality (2.8) gives ⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩/2 ≤ δ_n = f(x_n) - f^p(x_n), so that f^p(x_n) - f(x̄) ≤ f(x_n) - f(x̄) - (1/2)⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩. To obtain an over-estimation of f^p(x_n) - f(x̄), we under-estimate ⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩, first in terms of |g_n^p|^2 and next in terms of f^p(x_n) - f(x̄), using (4.5). We start from ⟨M_n s_n^p, s_n^p⟩ = |M_n s_n^p||s_n^p|cos θ_n, for all n ≥ 1. Fixing r in ]0, 1[, we denote by N_r^n the set of indices j in {1, …, n} for which (4.7) and (4.8) hold. Using successively (4.7), (4.8) and (4.5), and remembering from Lemma 2.1 that g_n^p = -M_n s_n^p, we write for all j ∈ N_r^n, ⟨M_j s_j^p, s_j^p⟩ ≥ γ_1|M_j s_j^p||s_j^p| ≥ (γ_1/γ_2)|M_j s_j^p|^2 = (γ_1/γ_2)|g_j^p|^2 ≥ C_1(f(x_j^p) - f(x̄)), where C_1 = αγ_1/γ_2. Adding (C_1/2)⟨M_j s_j^p, s_j^p⟩ to the extreme sides and using (2.6) give (1 + C_1/2)⟨M_j s_j^p, s_j^p⟩ ≥ C_1(f^p(x_j) - f(x̄)), for all j ∈ N_r^n, so that, as wished, (1/2)⟨M_j s_j^p, s_j^p⟩ ≥ C_2(f^p(x_j) - f(x̄)), for all j ∈ N_r^n, where C_2 = C_1/(2 + C_1). Combining this with (4.9) gives f^p(x_j) - f(x̄) ≤ (1/(1 + C_2))(f(x_j) - f(x̄)), for all j ∈ N_r^n. Now, using the line-search condition (2.9), we have for j ∈ N_r^n, f(x_{j+1}) - f(x̄) ≤ (1 - m)(f(x_j) - f(x̄)) + m(f^p(x_j) - f(x̄)) ≤ (1 - mC_2/(1 + C_2))(f(x_j) - f(x̄)). Remark that we can write 1 - mC_2/(1 + C_2) =: τ^{1/r} for some τ in ]0, 1[. Furthermore, as |N_r^n| ≥ rn (Lemma 4.4) and f(x_{j+1}) - f(x̄) ≤ f(x_j) - f(x̄) for all j, we have f(x_{n+1}) - f(x̄) ≤ τ^{|N_r^n|/r}(f(x_1) - f(x̄)) ≤ τ^n(f(x_1) - f(x̄)), for all n ≥ 1. Finally (4.4) allows us to deduce |x_n - x̄| ≤ [(f(x_n) - f(x̄))/α]^{1/2} ≤ [(f(x_1) - f(x̄))/α]^{1/2}(√τ)^{n-1}. This implies that limsup_{n→∞}|x_n - x̄|^{1/n} ≤ √τ < 1, characterizing the r-linear convergence of x_n to x̄. Finiteness of ∑_{n≥1}|x_n - x̄| follows.

定理 4.6.name: 定理 4.6
定理 4.6.content: 假设 x̄ 是 f 的一个极小点，且在 x̄ 处 (3.6) 和 (3.7) 成立，并且 g 的方向导数算子 H̄ 满足以下性质：存在 α > 0 使得对所有 z ∈ ℝ^N 有 ⟨H̄z, z⟩ ≥ α|z|²。如果 |x_n^+ - x̄| = o(|x_n - x̄|)，那么对于足够大的 n，点 x_n^+（由 (4.10) 定义）被算法 (BFGS-AP3) 的线搜索接受。
定理 4.6.proof_text: From (3.10), we have for z arbitrary in the neighbourhood of x̄: g(z) = H̄(z - x̄) + o(|z - x̄|), so that in particular, ⟨g_n^p, s_n^p⟩ = ⟨H̄ e_n^p, s_n^p⟩ + o(|e_n^p| |s_n^p|). For n large enough, we write (4.13) with z = x̄ + τ(x_n - x̄); we multiply by x_n - x̄ and we integrate from τ = 0 to τ = 1: f(x_n) = f(x̄) + 1/2 ⟨H̄ e_n, e_n⟩ + o(|e_n|²). The same operation with x_n^p instead of x_n gives f(x_n^p) = f(x̄) + 1/2 ⟨H̄ e_n^p, e_n^p⟩ + o(|e_n^p|²). These three relations give an estimate of δ_n = f(x_n) - f(x_n^p) + 1/2 ⟨g_n^p, s_n^p⟩: δ_n = 1/2 ⟨H̄ e_n, e_n⟩ - 1/2 ⟨H̄ e_n^p, e_n⟩ + o(|e_n|²), where we have used (4.12): s_n^p and e_n^p have the order of magnitude of e_n. In the second term, use the relation e_n = 2 e_n^p - (x_n^+ - x̄) = 2 e_n^p + o(|e_n|) to obtain δ_n = 1/2 ⟨H̄ e_n, e_n⟩ - ⟨H̄ e_n^p, e_n^p⟩ + o(|e_n|²). In summary, we have the following estimate for the right-hand side in (2.9): f(x_n) - m δ_n = f(x̄) + (1-m)/2 ⟨H̄ e_n, e_n⟩ + m ⟨H̄ e_n^p, e_n^p⟩ + o(|e_n|²) ≥ f(x̄) + (1-m)/2 α |e_n|² + o(|e_n|²), because m ∈ ]0, 1[. On the other hand, (4.13) can again be used to obtain the estimate (we set e_n^+ := x_n^+ - x̄) f(x_n^+) = f(x̄) + 1/2 ⟨H̄ e_n^+, e_n^+⟩ + o(|e_n^+|²) = f(x̄) + o(|e_n|²). Because (1-m)α/2 > 0, we conclude that our q-superlinear assumption ensures that (2.9) is eventually satisfied. It remains to take care of (4.3). From (4.13), setting s_n^+ := x_n^+ - x_n = -e_n + o(|e_n|), we write ⟨g(x_n^+), s_n^+⟩ = ⟨H̄ e_n^+, s_n^+⟩ + o(|e_n^+| |s_n^+|) = o(|e_n|²), ⟨g(x_n), s_n^+⟩ = ⟨H̄ e_n, s_n^+⟩ + o(|e_n|²) = -⟨H̄ e_n, e_n⟩ + o(|e_n|²). We therefore obtain ⟨g(x_n^+) - g(x_n), s_n^+⟩ = ⟨H̄ e_n, e_n⟩ + o(|e_n|²) ≥ α |e_n|² + o(|e_n|²). and this again is eventually positive.

Lemma 4.7.name: Lemma 4.7
Lemma 4.7.content: If {M_n} is generated by the BFGS formula using pairs of vectors (y_n, s_n) such that ⟨y_n, s_n⟩ > 0 for all n ≥ 1 and ∑_{n ≥ 1} |y_n - M s_n| / |s_n| < ∞, where M is a fixed symmetric positive definite matrix, then (M_n - M)s_n = o(|s_n|).

Theorem 4.8.name: Theorem 4.8
Theorem 4.8.content: Assume that the sequence {x_n} generated by Algorithm (BFGS-AP3) converges to an optimal point x̄, and that (3.6), (3.9) hold. Assume also that H̄ is positive definite. Then, the convergence of x_n to x̄ is q-superlinear.
Theorem 4.8.proof_text: First of all, we establish the necessary local properties of the gradient mapping. Take x and y in the neighbourhood of x̄ and apply (3.10): g(x) - g(y) = H̄(x - y) + o(|x - y|). This implies the Lipschitz continuity of g near x̄. Multiply this last relation by x - y: because H̄ is positive definite, g is (locally) strongly monotone, i.e., f is (locally) strongly convex. Thus, starting with Theorem 4.5 (all the assumptions required are satisfied): {x_n} converges r-superlinearly to x̄. Now, since (3.9) holds, we have |y_n - H̄ s_n| / |s_n| ≤ L(|x_{n+1} - x̄| + |x_n - x̄|). Therefore, by the r-linear convergence of {x_n}, ∑_{n ≥ 1} |y_n - H̄ s_n| / |s_n| < +∞. This and Lemma 4.7 give (M_n - H̄)s_n = o(|s_n|). Finally, the latter estimate and Theorem 3.6 imply that x_n + 2s_n^p - x̄ = o(|e_n|). Then Theorem 4.6 shows that the stepsize t_n = 2 is accepted by the line-search. Hence e_{n+1} = o(|e_n|) and the convergence is q-superlinear.

Theorem 4.5.name: Theorem 4.5
Theorem 4.5.content: Theorem 4.5 (assumed from context): a result about r-superlinear convergence of {x_n} under certain assumptions.

Theorem 3.6.name: Theorem 3.6
Theorem 3.6.content: Theorem 3.6 (assumed from context): a result used in the proof of Theorem 4.8.

Theorem 4.6.name: Theorem 4.6
Theorem 4.6.content: Theorem 4.6 (assumed from context): a result about the line-search accepting stepsize t_n = 2.

Theorem 4.2.name: Theorem 4.2
Theorem 4.2.content: Let {xᵏ} be the sequence produced by Algorithm 1 (constant step-size rule). If at step k one has ∇f(xᵏ⁻¹) ∈ 𝒱₀^⊥, then xᵏ⁻¹ is an optimal solution. Otherwise, the sequence {f(xᵏ)} is nonincreasing and converges to f_*. Moreover, suppose that the optimal set X_* is nonempty; then (a) if X_* is bounded, the sequence {xᵏ} is bounded with all its limit points in X_*; (b) if (d, H) ∈ ℱ₊(overline{C}), the sequence {xᵏ} converges to an optimal solution of (P).

条件 (3.8).name: 条件 (3.8)
条件 (3.8).content: 一个假设条件，用于保证准牛顿方程的有效性，确保g(x_n)和g(x_{n+1})反映邻近x处的g(x)值。

准牛顿方程 (3.1).name: 准牛顿方程 (3.1)
准牛顿方程 (3.1).content: 准牛顿算法中的核心方程，用于更新Hessian近似。

Definition 2.1.name: Definition 2.1
Definition 2.1.content: A function d: R^n × R^n → R_+ ∪ {+∞} is called a proximal distance with respect to an open nonempty convex set C ⊂ R^n if for each y ∈ C it satisfies: (P1) d(·, y) is proper, lsc, convex, and C^1 on C; (P2) dom d(·, y) ⊂ closure(C) and dom ∂_1 d(·, y) = C; (P3) d(·, y) is level bounded on R^n; (P4) d(y, y) = 0.
Definition 2.1.chapter_id: 2006-Auslender-Teboulle-Interior_gradient_proximal_convex_conic.correction.md::INTERIOR GRADIENT AND PROXIMAL METHODS FOR CONVEX AND CONIC OPTIMIZATION*

Definition 2.2.name: Definition 2.2
Definition 2.2.content: Given C ⊂ R^n, open and convex, and d ∈ D(C), a function H: R^n × R^n → R_+ ∪ {+∞} is called the induced proximal distance to d if H is finite valued on C × C and for each a, b ∈ C satisfies H(a, a) = 0 and ⟨c - b, ∇_1 d(b, a)⟩ ≤ H(c, a) - H(c, b) ∀c ∈ C.
Definition 2.2.chapter_id: 2006-Auslender-Teboulle-Interior_gradient_proximal_convex_conic.correction.md::INTERIOR GRADIENT AND PROXIMAL METHODS FOR CONVEX AND CONIC OPTIMIZATION*

Lemma 2.1.name: Lemma 2.1
Lemma 2.1.content: Let $(\phi_k)_{1 \leq k \leq m}$ be functions in $\Gamma_0(\mathcal{X})$, let $\mathcal{X}^m$ be the standard Hilbert product space, and let $\varphi: \mathcal{X}^m \to ]-\infty, +\infty]: (x_k)_{1 \leq k \leq m} \mapsto \sum_{k=1}^m \phi_k(x_k)$. Then $\partial \varphi = \times_{k=1}^m \partial \phi_k$.

Lemma 2.2.name: Lemma 2.2
Lemma 2.2.content: Let $\varphi\in\Gamma_{0}(\mathcal{Y})$, let $\psi\in\Gamma_{0}(\mathcal{X})$, and let $L\colon\mathcal{X}\to\mathcal{Y}$ be a bounded linear operator such that $0\in\operatorname{int}\left(\operatorname{dom}\varphi-L(\operatorname{dom}\psi)\right)$. Then (i) $\partial (\varphi \circ L + \psi) = L^{*}\circ (\partial \varphi)\circ L + \partial \psi$; (ii) $\inf_{x\in \mathcal{X}}\left(\varphi (Lx) + \psi (x)\right) = -\min_{v\in \mathcal{Y}}\left(\varphi^{*}(v) + \psi^{*}(-L^{*}v)\right)$ (Fenchel-Rockafellar duality formula).

Theorem 2.1.name: Theorem 2.1
Theorem 2.1.content: Let (d, H) ∈ F(C) and let {x^k} be the sequence generated by IPA. Set σ_n = ∑_{k=1}^n λ_k. Then the following hold: (i) f(x^n) - f(x) ≤ σ_n^{-1} H(x, x^0) + σ_n^{-1} ∑_{k=1}^n σ_k ε_k ∀x ∈ C. (ii) If lim_{n→∞} σ_n = +∞ and ε_k → 0, then liminf_{n→∞} f(x^n) = f_* and the sequence {f(x^k)} converges to f_* whenever ∑_{k=1}^∞ ε_k < ∞. (iii) Furthermore, suppose the optimal set X_* of problem (P) is nonempty, and consider the following cases: (a) X_* is bounded, (b) ∑_{k=1}^∞ λ_k ε_k < ∞ and (d, H) ∈ F(closure(C)). Then, under either (a) or (b), the sequence {x^k} is bounded with all its limit points in X_*.
Theorem 2.1.proof_text: (i) From (2.4), since g^k ∈ ∂_{ε_k} f(x^k) we have λ_k(f(x^k) - f(x)) ≤ ⟨x - x^k, ∇_1 d(x^k, x^{k-1})⟩ + λ_k ε_k ∀x ∈ C. Using (2.6) at the points c = x, a = x^{k-1}, b = x^k, the above inequality implies that λ_k(f(x^k) - f(x)) ≤ H(x, x^{k-1}) - H(x, x^k) + λ_k ε_k ∀x ∈ C. Summing over k = 1,…,n we obtain -σ_n f(x) + ∑_{k=1}^n λ_k f(x^k) ≤ H(x, x^0) - H(x, x^n) + ∑_{k=1}^n λ_k ε_k. Now setting x = x^{k-1} in (2.8), we obtain f(x^k) - f(x^{k-1}) ≤ ε_k. Multiplying the latter inequality by σ_{k-1} (with σ_0 ≡ 0) and summing over k = 1,…,n, we obtain, after some algebra, σ_n f(x^n) - ∑_{k=1}^n λ_k f(x^k) ≤ ∑_{k=1}^n σ_{k-1} ε_k. Adding this inequality to (2.9) and recalling that λ_k + σ_{k-1} = σ_k, it follows that f(x^n) - f(x) ≤ σ_n^{-1}[H(x, x^0) - H(x, x^n)] + σ_n^{-1} ∑_{k=1}^n σ_k ε_k ∀x ∈ C, proving (i), since H(·,·) ≥ 0. (ii) If σ_n → +∞ and ε_k → 0, then dividing (2.9) by σ_n and invoking Lemma 2.2(i), we obtain from (2.9) that liminf_{n→∞} f(x^n) ≤ inf{f(x) | x ∈ C}, which together with f(x^n) ≥ inf{f(x) | x ∈ closure(C)} implies that liminf_{n→∞} f(x^n) = inf{f(x) | x ∈ closure(C)} = f_*. From (2.10) we have 0 ≤ f(x^k) - f_* ≤ f(x^{k-1}) - f_* + ε_k. Then using Lemma 2.1 it follows that the sequence {f(x^k)} converges to f_* whenever ∑_{k=1}^∞ ε_k < ∞. (iii) Case (a): If X_* is bounded, then f is level bounded over closure(C), and since the sequence {f(x^k)} converges to f_*, it follows that the sequence {x^k} is bounded. Since f is lsc, passing to the limit, and recalling that {x^k} ⊂ C, it follows that each limit point is an optimal solution. Case (b): Here, we suppose that ∑_{k=1}^∞ λ_k ε_k < ∞ and that (d, H) ∈ F(closure(C)). Then (2.8) holds for each x ∈ closure(C), and in particular for x ∈ X_*, so that H(x, x^k) ≤ H(x, x^{k-1}) + λ_k ε_k ∀x ∈ X_*. Summing over k = 1,…,n, we obtain H(x, x^n) ≤ H(x, x^0) + ∑_{k=1}^∞ λ_k ε_k. But, since in this case H(x,·) is level bounded, the last inequality implies that the sequence {x^k} is bounded, and thus as in Case (a) it follows that all its limit points are in X_*.
Theorem 2.1.chapter_id: 2006-Auslender-Teboulle-Interior_gradient_proximal_convex_conic.correction.md::INTERIOR GRADIENT AND PROXIMAL METHODS FOR CONVEX AND CONIC OPTIMIZATION*

Corollary 2.1.name: Corollary 2.1
Corollary 2.1.content: Let (d, H) ∈ F(closure(C)), X_* ≠ ∅, and {x^k} be the sequence generated by IPA with ε_k = 0 ∀k. Then, f(x^n) - f_* = O(σ_n^{-1}).
Corollary 2.1.proof_text: Under the given hypothesis, Theorem 2.1(i) holds for any x ∈ closure(C), and it follows that f(x^n) - f_* ≤ (σ_n)^{-1} H(x^*, x^0).
Corollary 2.1.chapter_id: 2006-Auslender-Teboulle-Interior_gradient_proximal_convex_conic.correction.md::INTERIOR GRADIENT AND PROXIMAL METHODS FOR CONVEX AND CONIC OPTIMIZATION*

Theorem 2.2.name: Theorem 2.2
Theorem 2.2.content: Let (d, H) ∈ F_+(closure(C)) and let {x^k} be the sequence generated by IPA. Suppose that the optimal set X_* of (P) is nonempty, σ_n = ∑_{k=1}^n λ_k → ∞, ∑_{k=1}^∞ λ_k ε_k < ∞, and ∑_{k=1}^∞ ε_k < ∞. Then the sequence {x^k} converges to an optimal solution of (P).
Theorem 2.2.proof_text: Let x ∈ X_*. Then, since (d, H) ∈ F_+(closure(C)), from (2.12) with ∑_{k=1}^n λ_k ε_k < +∞ and Lemma 2.1 we obtain that the sequence {H(x, x^k)} converges to some a(x) ∈ R ∀x ∈ X_*. Let x_∞ be the limit of a subsequence {x^{k_l}}. Obviously, from Theorem 2.1, x_∞ ∈ X_*. Then by assumption (a_2) lim_{l→∞} H(x_∞, x^{k_l}) = 0, so that lim_{k→∞} H(x_∞, x^k) = 0, and by assumption (a_1) it follows that the sequence {x^k} converges to x_∞.
Theorem 2.2.chapter_id: 2006-Auslender-Teboulle-Interior_gradient_proximal_convex_conic.correction.md::INTERIOR GRADIENT AND PROXIMAL METHODS FOR CONVEX AND CONIC OPTIMIZATION*

Theorem 2.3.name: Theorem 2.3
Theorem 2.3.content: Let (d, H) ∈ F(C), and let {x^k} be a sequence generated by IPA1. Then we have the following: (i) The sequence {f(x^k)} converges to f_*. (ii) Furthermore, suppose that the optimal set X_* is nonempty, and consider the following cases: (a) X_* is bounded; (b) (d, H) ∈ F(closure(C)); (c) (d, H) ∈ F_+(closure(C)). Then under (a) or (b), the sequence {x^k} is bounded with all limit points in X_*, while under (c) the sequence {x^k} converges to an optimal solution.
Theorem 2.3.proof_text: Since g^k ∈ ∂f(x^k), using (2.6) and the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality we get for any x ∈ C: λ_k(f(x^k) - f(x)) ≤ ⟨x - x^k, ∇_1 d(x^k, x^{k-1})⟩ + ⟨e^k, x^k - x⟩ ≤ H(x, x^{k-1}) - H(x, x^k) + ε̃_k(x), with ε̃_k(x) := ‖e^k‖‖x‖ + ⟨x^k, e^k⟩. Summing over k = 1,…,n and dividing by σ_n = ∑_{k=1}^n λ_k we obtain -f(x) + ∑_{k=1}^n (λ_k f(x^k))/σ_n ≤ σ_n^{-1}[H(x, x^0) - H(x, x^n) + ∑_{k=1}^n ε̃_k(x)]. Now setting x = x^{k-1} in (2.15) and α_k := |ε̃_k(x^{k-1})|λ_*^{-1}, we obtain (f(x^k) - f(x^{k-1})) ≤ α_k. But using (2.14), one has ∑_{k=1}^∞ ε̃_k(x) < ∞ and ∑_{k=1}^∞ α_k < ∞. Therefore by passing to the limit in (2.16) and invoking Lemma 2.2(i) it follows that liminf_{n→∞} f(x^n) - f(x) ≤ 0 for each x ∈ C so that liminf_{n→∞} f(x^n) ≤ inf{f(x) | x ∈ C}. From here, the proof can be completed with the same arguments as in the proofs of Theorems 2.1 and 2.2.
Theorem 2.3.chapter_id: 2006-Auslender-Teboulle-Interior_gradient_proximal_convex_conic.correction.md::INTERIOR GRADIENT AND PROXIMAL METHODS FOR CONVEX AND CONIC OPTIMIZATION*

φ-divergence kernel definition.name: φ-divergence kernel definition
φ-divergence kernel definition.content: Let φ : ℝ → ℝ ∪ {+∞} be an lsc, convex, proper function such that dom φ ⊂ ℝ₊ and dom ∂φ = ℝ₊₊. We suppose in addition that φ is C², strictly convex, and nonnegative on ℝ₊₊ with φ(1) = φ'(1) = 0. We denote by Φ the class of such kernels and by Φ₁ the subclass satisfying φ''(1)(1 - 1/t) ≤ φ'(t) ≤ φ''(1) log t ∀ t > 0. The subclass Φ₂ satisfies φ''(1)(1 - 1/t) ≤ φ'(t) ≤ φ''(1)(t - 1) ∀ t > 0.

φ-divergence proximal distance definitio.name: φ-divergence proximal distance definition
φ-divergence proximal distance definitio.content: Corresponding to the classes Φᵣ, with r = 1,2, we define a φ-divergence proximal distance by d_φ(x, y) = Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ yᵢʳ φ(xᵢ / yᵢ). For any φ ∈ Φ, since argmin{φ(t) | t ∈ ℝ} = {1}, φ is coercive and thus it follows that d_φ ∈ 𝒟(C), with C = ℝ₊₊ⁿ.

Kullback-Leibler divergence as induced p.name: Kullback-Leibler divergence as induced proximal distance for Φ₁
Kullback-Leibler divergence as induced p.content: The induced proximal distance H associated with d_φ for φ ∈ Φ₁ is the Bregman proximal distance obtained from the kernel h(x) = Σⱼ₌₁ⁿ xⱼ log xⱼ and given by D_h(x, y) := K(x, y) = Σⱼ₌₁ⁿ xⱼ log(xⱼ / yⱼ) + yⱼ - xⱼ ∀ x ∈ ℝ₊ⁿ, ∀ y ∈ ℝ₊₊ⁿ, which is the Kullback–Leibler relative entropy.

Key inequality for Φ₁.name: Key inequality for Φ₁
Key inequality for Φ₁.content: For any φ ∈ Φ₁ one has ⟨c - b, ∇₁ d_φ(b, a)⟩ ≤ φ''(1)[K(c, a) - K(c, b)].

Key inequality for Φ₂.name: Key inequality for Φ₂
Key inequality for Φ₂.content: For φ(t) = μ p(t) + (ν/2)(t-1)² with ν ≥ μ > 0, p ∈ Φ₂, and d_φ(x, y) = Σⱼ₌₁ⁿ yⱼ² φ(xⱼ / yⱼ), one has ⟨c - b, ∇₁ d(b, a)⟩ ≤ η(||c - a||² - ||c - b||²) ∀ a, b ∈ ℝ₊₊, ∀ c ∈ ℝ₊ with η = 2⁻¹(μ + ν).

Theorem 4.1.name: Theorem 4.1
Theorem 4.1.content: Let {xᵏ} be a sequence generated by PSA with (d, H) ∈ ℱ(C). Set σₙ = Σₖ₌₁ⁿ λₖ and αₖ = ⟨gᵏ⁻¹, xᵏ⁻¹ - xᵏ⟩. Then, (i) Σₖ₌₁^∞ αₖ < ∞, Σₖ₌₁^∞ εₖ < ∞, and αₖ ≥ λₖ⁻¹ H(xᵏ, xᵏ⁻¹) ≥ 0 ∀ k ∈ ℕ. (ii) ∀ z ∈ C, f(xⁿ) - f(z) ≤ σₙ⁻¹[H(z, x⁰) + Σₖ₌₁ⁿ λₖ(αₖ + εₖ)]. (iii) The sequence {f(xᵏ)} is nonincreasing and converges to f_* as σₙ → ∞. (iv) Suppose that the optimal set X_* is nonempty and σₙ → ∞. Then the sequence {xᵏ} is bounded with all its limit points in X_* under either (a) X_* is bounded, or (b) (d, H) ∈ ℱ(overline{C}) and Σₖ₌₁^∞ λₖ εₖ < +∞. In addition, if (d, H) ∈ ℱ₊(overline{C}), then {xᵏ} converges to an optimal solution of (P).

Corollary 4.1.name: Corollary 4.1
Corollary 4.1.content: Let (d, H) ∈ ℱ(overline{C}) and let {xᵏ} be the sequence produced by PSA. Suppose that X_* ≠ ∅ and 0 < λ_* ≤ λₖ ≤ λ*. Then we have the global estimation f(xⁿ) - f_* = O(n⁻¹).

Theorem 4.3.name: Theorem 4.3
Theorem 4.3.content: Suppose that G ≠ ∅. Let (γ_n) be a sequence in ]0,+∞[ such that 0 < inf γ_n ≤ sup γ_n < 2(Σ_{i=1}^m ||L_i||^2/ρ_i)^{-1}, let (λ_n) be a sequence in ]0,1] such that inf λ_n > 0, and let (a_n) and ((b_{i,n})) be sequences in H such that Σ ||a_n|| < +∞ and max_i Σ ||b_{i,n}|| < +∞. Fix x_0 ∈ H and, for every n, set x_{n+1} = x_n + λ_n(prox_{γ_n f_1}(x_n + γ_n(Σ_{i=1}^m (1/ρ_i)((L_i^* ∘ (prox_{ρ_i φ_i} - Id) ∘ L_i)x_n + b_{i,n}))) + a_n - x_n). Then: (i) (x_n) converges weakly to a point x ∈ G. (ii) (x_n) converges strongly to x if and only if lim inf d_G(x_n) = 0.
Theorem 4.3.proof_text: The proof is a consequence of Proposition 4.2 and Theorem 3.4(i)&(iv) with b_n = -Σ_{i=1}^m b_{i,n}/ρ_i and ∇f_2 given by (4.4).
Theorem 4.3.chapter_id: 2005-Combettes-Wajs_Prox_SIAM.correction.md::4. Problems involving sums of Moreau envelopes.

Lemma 5.1.name: Lemma 5.1
Lemma 5.1.content: Let $T$ : $\operatorname{dom} T = \mathcal{H} \to \mathcal{H}$ be a nonexpansive operator, let $(\mu_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $]0, 1[$ , and let $(c_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $\mathcal{H}$ . Suppose that $\operatorname{Fix} T \neq \emptyset$ , $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{N}} \mu_n (1 - \mu_n) = +\infty$ , and $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{N}} \mu_n \|c_n\| < +\infty$ . Take $x_0 \in \mathcal{H}$ and set $(\forall n \in \mathbb {N}) x _ {n + 1} = x _ {n} + \mu_ {n} (T x _ {n} + c _ {n} - x _ {n})$. Then $(x_{n})_{n\in \mathbb{N}}$ converges weakly to a point in $\operatorname {Fix}T$.
Lemma 5.1.proof_text: The recursion (5.1) is a specialization of (4.1) with $(\forall n \in \mathbb {N}) T _ {1, n} = \mathrm{Id} + \mu_ {n} (T - \mathrm{Id}) \in \mathcal {A} (\mu_ {n}), \lambda_ {n} = 1, \alpha_ {1, n} = \mu_ {n}, \text {and} e _ {1, n} = \mu_ {n} c _ {n}$. It is clear that conditions (i) and (iii) are satisfied in Theorem 4.2. In view of (4.2) and (5.2), to check (ii) it is enough to verify that for an arbitrary suborbit $(x_{k_n})_{n\in \mathbb{N}}$ we have $\left\{\begin{aligned}\sum_ {n &\in \mathbb {N}} \mu_ {n} (1 - \mu_ {n}) \| T x _ {n} - x _ {n} \| ^ {2} <   + \infty\\x _ {k _ {n}} \rightharpoonup y\end{aligned}\right. \quad \Rightarrow \quad T y = y$. To this end, suppose that $\sum_{n\in \mathbb{N}}\mu_n(1 - \mu_n)\| Tx_n - x_n\|^2 < +\infty$ . Since $\sum_{n\in \mathbb{N}}\mu_n(1 - \mu_n) = +\infty$ , we get $\underline{\lim}\| Tx_n - x_n\| = 0$ . However, it follows from (5.1) that $(\forall n \in \mathbb {N}) \| T x _ {n + 1} - x _ {n + 1} \| \leq \| T x _ {n + 1} - T x _ {n} \| + (1 - \mu_ {n}) \| T x _ {n} - x _ {n} \| + \mu_ {n} \| c _ {n} \| \leq \quad \| x _ {n + 1} - x _ {n} \| + (1 - \mu_ {n}) \| T x _ {n} - x _ {n} \| + \mu_ {n} \| c _ {n} \| \leq \quad \| T x _ {n} - x _ {n} \| + 2 \mu_ {n} \| c _ {n} \|$. Since $\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\mu_n\|c_n\|<+\infty$ , the sequence $(\|Tx_n-x_n\|)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ converges and therefore $Tx_n-x_n\to0$ . If, in addition, $x_{k_n}\rightharpoonup y$ , then it follows at once from the demiclosed principle for nonexpansive operators [14, Lemma 4] that $Ty=y$.

Lemma 5.2.name: Lemma 5.2
Lemma 5.2.content: For any k ≥ 0, one has qₖ(x) = qₖ* + cₖ H(x, zᵏ) ∀ x ∈ overline{C} ∩ 𝒱 with zᵏ = argmin_{x ∈ overline{C} ∩ 𝒱} qₖ(x), qₖ* = qₖ(zᵏ), c₀ = c, z⁰ = x⁰ ∈ C ∩ 𝒱. Furthermore, the sequence {zᵏ} ∈ C ∩ 𝒱 is uniquely defined by z^{k+1} = u(αₖ / c_{k+1} ∇f(yᵏ), zᵏ), where the positive sequence {cₖ} satisfies c_{k+1} = (1 - αₖ)cₖ.

Theorem 5.1.name: Theorem 5.1
Theorem 5.1.content: Let σ > 0, L > 0 be given. Suppose that for some k ≥ 0 we have a point xᵏ ∈ C ∩ 𝒱 such that f(xᵏ) ≤ qₖ* = min{qₖ(x) : x ∈ overline{C} ∩ 𝒱}. Let αₖ ∈ [0,1), c_{k+1} = (1 - αₖ)cₖ, and C ∩ 𝒱 ∋ {zᵏ} be given by (5.11). Define yᵏ = (1 - αₖ)xᵏ + αₖ zᵏ, x^{k+1} = (1 - αₖ)xᵏ + αₖ z^{k+1}. Then, the following inequality holds: q_{k+1}* ≥ f(x^{k+1}) + (1/2)((c_{k+1}σ)/αₖ² - L) ||x^{k+1} - yᵏ||².

Lemma 5.3.name: Lemma 5.3
Lemma 5.3.content: Let λₖ > 0, cₖ > 0 with c₀ = c, and let {αₖ} be the sequence with αₖ ∈ [0,1[ defined by αₖ² = λₖ cₖ (1 - αₖ) with c_{k+1} = (1 - αₖ)cₖ. Set γₖ := Π_{l=0}^{k-1} (1 - αₗ). Then γₖ ≤ (1 + (√c)/2 Σ_{l=0}^{k-1} √λₗ)⁻². In particular, with λₗ = λ ∀ l we have γₖ ≤ 4(k√(λc) + 2)⁻².

Theorem 5.2.name: Theorem 5.2
Theorem 5.2.content: Let {xᵏ}, {yᵏ} be the sequences generated by IGA and let x* be an optimal solution of (P). Then for any k ≥ 0 we have f(xᵏ) - f(x*) ≤ (4L)/(σ k² c) C(x*, x⁰) = O(1/k²), where C(x*, x⁰) = c₀ H(x*, x⁰) + f(x⁰) - f(x*) and the sequence {xᵏ} is minimizing, i.e., f(xᵏ) → f(x*).

Definition 1.1.name: Definition 1.1
Definition 1.1.content: Let α ∈ ]0,1[. An operator T: dom T = H → H is nonexpansive if (∀(x,y) ∈ H^2) ||Tx - Ty|| ≤ ||x - y||, and α-averaged if T = (1-α)Id + αR for some nonexpansive operator R: dom R = H → H. The class of α-averaged operators on H is denoted by A(α). In particular, A(1/2) is the class of firmly nonexpansive operators.

Firmly nonexpansive operator and resolve.name: Firmly nonexpansive operator and resolvent equivalence
Firmly nonexpansive operator and resolve.content: An operator T: dom T = H → H is firmly nonexpansive if and only if it is the resolvent of a maximal monotone operator A: H → 2^H, i.e., T = J_A.

子微分定义.name: 子微分定义
子微分定义.content: The subdifferential of a proper function $f: \mathcal{H} \to ]-\infty, +\infty]$ is the set-valued operator $\partial f \colon \mathcal {H} \rightarrow 2 ^ {\mathcal {H}} \colon x \mapsto \left\{u \in \mathcal {H} \mid (\forall y \in \mathcal {H}) \quad \langle y - x \mid u \rangle + f (x) \leq f (y) \right\}$.

Γ₀(ℋ)类定义.name: Γ₀(ℋ)类定义
Γ₀(ℋ)类定义.content: $\Gamma_0(\mathcal{H})$ denotes the class of proper, lower semicontinuous convex functions from $\mathcal{H}$ to $[- \infty, +\infty]$.

邻近算子与Moreau包络定义.name: 邻近算子与Moreau包络定义
邻近算子与Moreau包络定义.content: If $f \in \Gamma_0(\mathcal{H})$, then $\mathrm{prox}_f = J_{\partial f}$ is Moreau's proximity operator; moreover, the Moreau envelope of index $\gamma \in ]0, +\infty[$ of $f$ is the function ${}^\gamma f: x \mapsto \min_{y \in \mathcal{H}} f(y) + \frac{1}{2\gamma} \|x - y\|^2$.

指示函数与投影算子定义.name: 指示函数与投影算子定义
指示函数与投影算子定义.content: Let $C$ be a subset of $\mathcal{H}$. Then $d_C$ is the distance function to $C$, int $C$ its interior, $\overline{C}$ its closure, and $\iota_C$ its indicator function, which takes the value 0 on $C$ and $+\infty$ on its complement. If $C$ is nonempty, closed, and convex, then $P_C$ is the projector onto $C$ and $N_C = \partial \iota_C$ its normal cone operator.

集值算子相关定义.name: 集值算子相关定义
集值算子相关定义.content: Let $A: \mathcal{H} \to 2^{\mathcal{H}}$ be a set-valued operator. The sets $\mathrm{dom} A = \{x \in \mathcal{H} \mid Ax \neq \emptyset\}$, $\mathrm{ran} A = \{u \in \mathcal{H} \mid (\exists x \in \mathcal{H}) u \in Ax\}$, and $\mathrm{gr} A = \{(x, u) \in \mathcal{H}^2 \mid u \in Ax\}$ are the domain, the range, and the graph of $A$, respectively. The inverse $A^{-1}$ of $A$ is the set-valued operator with graph $\{(u, x) \in \mathcal{H}^2 \mid u \in Ax\}$. The resolvent of $A$ is $J_A = (\mathrm{Id} + A)^{-1}$ and its Yosida approximation of index $\gamma \in ]0, +\infty[$ is ${}^\gamma A = \frac {\mathrm{Id} - J _ {\gamma A}}{\gamma} = (\gamma \mathrm{Id} + A ^ {- 1}) ^ {- 1}$.

不动点集定义.name: 不动点集定义
不动点集定义.content: Fix $T = \{x \in \mathcal{H} \mid Tx = x\}$ denotes the set of fixed points of an operator $T: \mathcal{H} \to \mathcal{H}$.

定向复合积定义.name: 定向复合积定义
定向复合积定义.content: Given operators $(T_k)_{1 \leq k \leq m}$ from $\mathcal{H}$ to $\mathcal{H}$ and a strictly positive integer $i$, we define (the directed composition product) $\prod_ {k = i} ^ {m} T _ {k} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} T _ {i} T _ {i + 1} \dots T _ {m}, & \text {if} i \leq m; \\ \operatorname{Id}, & \text {otherwise.} \end{array} \right.$

引理 2.2.name: 引理 2.2
引理 2.2.content: Let $(T_{i})_{1\leq i\leq m}$ be a finite family of operators from H to H, let $(\omega_{i})_{1\leq i\leq m}$ be real numbers in ]0,1] adding up to 1, and let $(\alpha_{i})_{1\leq i\leq m}$ be real numbers in ]0,1[ such that, for every $i\in\{1,\ldots,m\}$ , $T_{i}\in\mathcal{A}(\alpha_{i})$ . Then: (i) $(\forall i \in \{1, \ldots, m\})(\forall \lambda \in ]0, 1/\alpha_i[)$ $\mathrm{Id} + \lambda(T_i - \mathrm{Id}) \in \mathcal{A}(\lambda\alpha_i).$ (ii) $\sum_{i=1}^{m} \omega_i T_i \in \mathcal{A}(\alpha)$ , with $\alpha = \max_{1 \leq i \leq m} \alpha_i$ . (iii) $T_{1}\dots T_{m}\in \mathcal{A}(\alpha)$, with $$ \alpha = \frac{m}{m - 1 + \frac{1}{\max_{1\leq i\leq m}\alpha_i}}.\tag{2.7} $$ (iv) If $\bigcap_{i=1}^{m}\mathrm{Fix}T_i\neq\emptyset$ , then $\bigcap_{i=1}^{m}\mathrm{Fix}T_i=\mathrm{Fix}T_1\cdots T_m=\mathrm{Fix}\sum_{i=1}^{m}\omega_iT_i$ .
引理 2.2.proof_text: (i): Fix $i \in \{1, \dots, m\}$ and $\lambda \in ]0, 1/\alpha_i[$ . Then, $T_i = (1 - \alpha_i)\mathrm{Id} + \alpha_iR_i$ for some nonexpansive operator $R_i \colon \mathcal{H} \to \mathcal{H}$ . Hence $\mathrm{Id} + \lambda(T_i - \mathrm{Id}) = (1 - \lambda\alpha_i)\mathrm{Id} + \lambda\alpha_iR_i \in \mathcal{A}(\lambda\alpha_i)$ . (ii): Set $T = \sum_{i=1}^{m}\omega_iT_i$ and $\mathrm{fix}(x,y) \in \mathcal{H}^2$ . Since $\alpha = \max_{1 \leq i \leq m} \alpha_i$ , Lemma 2.1(ii) yields $$ (\forall i \in \{1, \dots , m \}) \| T _ {i} x - T _ {i} y \| ^ {2} + \frac {1 - \alpha_ {i}}{\alpha_ {i}} \| (\operatorname{Id} - T _ {i}) x - (\operatorname{Id} - T _ {i}) y \| ^ {2} \leq \| x - y \| ^ {2}. \tag {2.8} $$ Hence, by convexity of $\|\cdot\|^{2}$, $$ \begin{array}{l} \| T x - T y \| ^ {2} + \frac {1 - \alpha}{\alpha} \| (\mathrm{Id} - T) x - (\mathrm{Id} - T) y \| ^ {2} \\ { = } { \left\| \sum _ { i = 1 } ^ { m } \omega _ { i } T _ { i } x - \sum _ { i = 1 } ^ { m } \omega _ { i } T _ { i } y \right\| ^ { 2 } + \frac { 1 - \alpha } { \alpha } \left\| \sum _ { i = 1 } ^ { m } \omega _ { i } ( \mathrm{Id} - T _ { i } ) x - \sum _ { i = 1 } ^ { m } \omega _ { i } ( \mathrm{Id} - T _ { i } ) y \right\| ^ { 2 }} \\ \leq \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} \omega_ {i} \| T _ {i} x - T _ {i} y \| ^ {2} + \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} \frac {1 - \alpha_ {i}}{\alpha_ {i}} \omega_ {i} \| (\operatorname{Id} - T _ {i}) x - (\operatorname{Id} - T _ {i}) y \| ^ {2} \\ \leq \| x - y \| ^ {2}. \tag {2.9} \\ \end{array} $$ (iii): Set $T = T_{1} \cdots T_{m}$ , $(\forall i \in \{1, \dots, m\})$ $\kappa_{i} = \alpha_{i} / (1 - \alpha_{i})$ , and $\kappa = \max_{1 \leq i \leq m} \kappa_{i}$ . In addition, fix $(x, y) \in \mathcal{H}^{2}$ . Then we derive from the convexity of $\| \cdot \|^{2}$ and Lemma 2.1(ii) that $$ \begin{array}{l} \| (\mathrm{Id} - T) x - (\mathrm{Id} - T) y \| ^ {2} / m = \| (x - y) - (T _ {m} x - T _ {m} y) + (T _ {m} x - T _ {m} y) \\ - \left(T _ {m - 1} T _ {m} x - T _ {m - 1} T _ {m} y\right) + \left(T _ {m - 1} T _ {m} x - T _ {m - 1} T _ {m} y\right) - \dots \\ - \left(T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} x - T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} y\right) + \left(T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} x - T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} y\right) \\ - (T _ {1} \dots T _ {m} x - T _ {1} \dots T _ {m} y) \| ^ {2} / m \\ = \quad \| (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {m}) x - (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {m}) y \\ + (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {m - 1}) T _ {m} x - (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {m - 1}) T _ {m} y + \dots \\ + (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {1}) T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} x - (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {1}) T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} y \| ^ {2} / m \\ \leq \left\| (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {m}) x - (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {m}) y \right\| ^ {2} \\ + \left\| (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {m - 1}) T _ {m} x - (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {m - 1}) T _ {m} y \right\| ^ {2} + \dots \\ + \left\| (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {1}) T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} x - (\mathrm{Id} - T _ {1}) T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} y \right\| ^ {2} \\ \leq \kappa_ {m} \left(\| x - y \| ^ {2} - \| T _ {m} x - T _ {m} y \| ^ {2}\right) \\ + \kappa_ {m - 1} \big (\| T _ {m} x - T _ {m} y \| ^ {2} - \| T _ {m - 1} T _ {m} x - T _ {m - 1} T _ {m} y \| ^ {2} \big) + \dots \\ + \kappa_ {1} \left(\| T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} x - T _ {2} \dots T _ {m} y \| ^ {2} - \| T _ {1} \dots T _ {m} x - T _ {1} \dots T _ {m} y \| ^ {2}\right) \\ \leq \kappa \big (\| x - y \| ^ {2} - \| T x - T y \| ^ {2} \big). \tag {2.10} \\ \end{array} $$ Consequently, Lemma 2.1 asserts that $T \in \mathcal{A}(\alpha)$ , with $\alpha = m / (m + 1 / \kappa)$ . This is precisely the expression provided in (2.7). (iv): Fix $i \in \{1, \dots, m\}$ , $x \in \mathcal{H} \setminus \text{Fix } T_i$ , and $y \in \text{Fix } T_i$ . Then it follows from Lemma 2.1(ii) that $\| T_i x - y \| < \| x - y \|$ , i.e., $T_i$ is attracting in the sense of [9, Definition 2.1]. The two identities therefore follow from [9, Proposition 2.10(i)] and [9, Proposition 2.12(i)].

引理 2.3.name: 引理 2.3
引理 2.3.content: Suppose that $B: \mathcal{H} \to \mathcal{H}$ and $\beta \in ]0, +\infty[$ satisfy $\beta B \in \mathcal{A}(\frac{1}{2})$ , and let $\gamma \in ]0, 2\beta[$ . Then, $\operatorname{Id} - \gamma B \in \mathcal{A}(\frac{\gamma}{2\beta})$ .
引理 2.3.proof_text: Since $\beta B \in \mathcal{A}(\frac{1}{2})$ , there exists a nonexpansive operator $R: \mathcal{H} \to \mathcal{H}$ such that $B = (\mathrm{Id} + R)/(2\beta)$ . In turn, $$ \operatorname{Id} - \gamma B = \left(1 - \frac {\gamma}{2 \beta}\right) \operatorname{Id} + \frac {\gamma}{2 \beta} (- R) \in \mathcal {A} \left(\frac {\gamma}{2 \beta}\right). \tag {2.11} $$

引理 2.4.name: 引理 2.4
引理 2.4.content: Let T: H → H. Then T ∈ A(1/2) if and only if T = J_A for some maximal monotone operator A: H → 2^H.

引理 2.5.name: 引理 2.5
引理 2.5.content: Let A: H → 2^H be a maximal monotone operator and let γ ∈ ]0,+∞[. Then (i) γ(γA) ∈ A(1/2). (ii) The set Fix J_{γA} = A^{-1}(0) = (^γ A)^{-1}(0) is closed and convex. (iii) gr A is sequentially weakly-strongly closed in H×H. (iv) (∀z∈A^{-1}(0))(∀x∈H) ||J_A x - x||^2 ≤ ⟨z - x | J_A x - x⟩.
引理 2.5.proof_text: (i): It follows from Lemma 2.4 that J_{γA} ∈ A(1/2). However, in view of Lemma 2.1(ii), J_{γA} ∈ A(1/2) ⇔ γ(γA) = Id - J_{γA} ∈ A(1/2). (ii): [3, Proposition 3.5.6.1]. (iii): [3, Proposition 3.5.6.2]. (iv): Fix z ∈ A^{-1}(0), x ∈ H, and set T = J_A. Then (2.13) yields z = Tz. Hence, we deduce from Lemma 2.4 and Lemma 2.1(iii) that ||Tx - z||^2 ≤ ⟨Tx - z | x - z⟩. Hence, ⟨Tx - z | Tx - x⟩ ≤ 0 and, in turn, ||Tx - x||^2 ≤ ⟨z - x | Tx - x⟩.

引理 2.6.name: 引理 2.6
引理 2.6.content: Let A, B: H → 2^H be two maximal monotone operators, let γ ∈ ]0,+∞[, and set T = R_{γA}R_{γB}. Then (i) T is nonexpansive. (ii) 1/2(T + Id) = J_{γA}(2J_{γB} - Id) - J_{γB} + Id. (iii) (A+B)^{-1}(0) = J_{γB}(Fix T).
引理 2.6.proof_text: (i): Lemma 2.4 asserts that J_{γA} and J_{γB} belong to A(1/2). Therefore, R_{γA} and R_{γB} are nonexpansive and it follows that R_{γA}R_{γB} is nonexpansive as the composition of two nonexpansive operators. (ii): T + Id = 2J_{γA}(2J_{γB} - Id) - (2J_{γB} - Id) + Id = 2(J_{γA}(2J_{γB} - Id) - J_{γB} + Id). (iii): For every y ∈ H, 0 ∈ Ay + By ⇔ ... ⇔ y ∈ J_{γB}(Fix T).

Lemma 2.7.name: Lemma 2.7
Lemma 2.7.content: Let (α_n)_{n∈ℕ} be a sequence in [0,+∞[, let (β_n)_{n∈ℕ} be a summable sequence in [0,+∞[, and let (ε_n)_{n∈ℕ} be a summable sequence in [0,+∞[ such that (∀n∈ℕ) α_{n+1} ≤ (1+β_n)α_n + ε_n. Then (α_n)_{n∈ℕ} converges.

Lemma 2.8.name: Lemma 2.8
Lemma 2.8.content: Let C be a nonempty closed subset of H and let (x_n)_{n∈ℕ} be a sequence in H which is quasi-Fejér monotone with respect to C, i.e., there exists a summable sequence (ε_n)_{n∈ℕ} in [0,+∞[ such that (∀x∈C)(∀n∈ℕ) ‖x_{n+1} - x‖ ≤ ‖x_n - x‖ + ε_n. Then: (i) The sequence (x_n)_{n∈ℕ} is bounded. (ii) The sequence (x_n)_{n∈ℕ} converges weakly to a point in C if and only if 𝔚(x_n)_{n∈ℕ} ⊂ C. (iii) The sequence (x_n)_{n∈ℕ} converges strongly to a point in C if and only if liminf d_C(x_n) = 0. (iv) If int C ≠ ∅, then the sequence (x_n)_{n∈ℕ} converges strongly to a point in ℋ.

Corollary 5.2.name: Corollary 5.2

Corollary 5.3.name: Corollary 5.3
Corollary 5.3.content: Let $\gamma \in ]0, +\infty[$ and let $(a_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ and $(b_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be sequences in $\mathcal{H}$ . Suppose that $\operatorname{int}(A + B)^{-1}(0) \neq \emptyset$ and that $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{N}} (\|a_n\| + \|b_n\|) < +\infty$ . Take $x_0 \in \mathcal{H}$ and set $(\forall n \in \mathbb {N}) x _ {n + 1} = 2 \left(J _ {\gamma A} \left(2 \left(J _ {\gamma B} x _ {n} + b _ {n}\right) - x _ {n}\right) + a _ {n}\right) - 2 \left(J _ {\gamma B} x _ {n} + b _ {n}\right) + x _ {n}$. Then $(x_{n})_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ converges strongly to some point $x\in\mathcal{H}$ such that $J_{\gamma B}x\in(A+B)^{-1}(0)$ and $(J_{\gamma B}x_{n})_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ converges strongly to $J_{\gamma B}x$.
Corollary 5.3.proof_text: Set $T = R_{\gamma A}R_{\gamma B}$ and define $(c_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ as in (5.6). Then it follows from Lemma 2.6(ii) that (5.9) can be rewritten as $(\forall n \in \mathbb{N}) \quad x_{n+1} = Tx_n + c_n$ . Now fix $y \in \operatorname{Fix} T$ , which is nonempty by Lemma 2.6(iii). Then $(\forall n \in \mathbb{N}) \quad \|x_{n+1} - y\| \leq \|Tx_n - y\| + \|c_n\| \leq \|x_n - y\| + \|c_n\|$ . Hence, since by nonexpansivity of $R_{\gamma A}$ (5.6) yields $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{N}} \|c_n\| \leq 2\sum_{n \in \mathbb{N}} (\|a_n\| + \|b_n\|) < +\infty$ , $(x_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ is a quasi-Fejér sequence with respect to Fix $T$ . Since int Fix $T \neq \emptyset$ , it follows from Lemma 2.8(iv) that $(x_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ converges strongly to some point $x \in \mathcal{H}$ . Hence, by continuity of $T$ , $Tx_n \to Tx$ and, since $c_n \to 0$ , we obtain $x \leftarrow x_{n+1} = Tx_n + c_n \to Tx$ . In turn, this yields $x \in \operatorname{Fix} T$ and, via Lemma 2.6(iii), $J_{\gamma B}x \in (A + B)^{-1}(0)$ . The continuity of $J_{\gamma B}$ allows us to conclude that $J_{\gamma B}x_n \to J_{\gamma B}x$.

假设 6.1.name: 假设 6.1
假设 6.1.content: A: H → 2^H 和 B: H → H 是极大单调算子，且存在某个 β ∈ (0, +∞) 使得 βB ∈ A(1/2)。

Algorithm 6.2.name: Algorithm 6.2
Algorithm 6.2.content: Fix $x_0 \in \mathcal{H}$ and, for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, set $$x_{n+1} = x_n + \lambda_n \big(T_{1,n}(T_{2,n}x_n + e_{2,n}) + e_{1,n} - x_n\big),$$ where $T_{1,n}\in \mathcal{A}(\alpha_{1,n})$ and $T_{2,n}\in \mathcal{A}(\alpha_{2,n})$, with $(\alpha_{1,n},\alpha_{2,n})\in ]0,1[^2$, $(e_{1,n},e_{2,n})\in \mathcal{H}^2$, and $\lambda_n\in ]0,1]$.

Theorem 6.3.name: Theorem 6.3
Theorem 6.3.content: Suppose that the following conditions are satisfied. (i) $G = \bigcap_{n\in \mathbb{N}}\mathrm{Fix}\left(T_{1,n}T_{2,n}\right)\neq \emptyset$. (ii) $\underline{\lim}\lambda_n > 0$, $\overline{\lim}\alpha_{1,n} < 1$, and $\overline{\lim}\alpha_{2,n} < 1$. (iii) For every subsequence $(x_{k_n})_{n\in \mathbb{N}}$ of an orbit $(x_{n})_{n\in \mathbb{N}}$ generated by Algorithm 6.2, we have $$\left\{\begin{aligned}(\forall x &\in G) \sum_{n \in \mathbb{N}} \| (\operatorname{Id} - T_{1,n}) T_{2,n} x_n + (\operatorname{Id} - T_{2,n}) x \|^2 < +\infty\\(\forall x &\in G) \sum_{n \in \mathbb{N}} \| (\operatorname{Id} - T_{2,n}) x_n - (\operatorname{Id} - T_{2,n}) x \|^2 < +\infty\\\sum_{n &\in \mathbb{N}} \| T_{1,n} T_{2,n} x_n - x_n \|^2 < +\infty\\x_{k_n} \rightharpoonup y\end{aligned}\right. \Rightarrow y \in G.$$ (iv) $\sum_{n\in \mathbb{N}}\| e_{1,n}\| < +\infty$ and $\sum_{n\in \mathbb{N}}\| e_{2,n}\| < +\infty$. Then every orbit of Algorithm 6.2 converges weakly to a point in $G$.

Partial Yosida approximation.name: Partial Yosida approximation
Partial Yosida approximation.content: Fix parameters (ρ_i)_{1≤i≤m} in ]0, +∞[. The partial Yosida approximation to problem (1.3) is: Find x ∈ H such that 0 ∈ A_0 x + ∑_{i=1}^m ρ_i A_i x, and its set of solutions is denoted by G, i.e., G = (A_0 + ∑_{i=1}^m ρ_i A_i)^{-1}(0).
Partial Yosida approximation.chapter_id: 2004-Combettes-Monotone_Averaged.correction.md::6.3 Partial Yosida approximation of monotone inclusions

Algorithm 6.11.name: Algorithm 6.11
Algorithm 6.11.content: Fix x_0 ∈ H and, for every n ∈ N, set x_{n+1} = x_n + λ_n (J_{βμ_n A_0}(x_n + μ_n (∑_{i=1}^m ω_i (J_{ρ_i A_i} x_n + b_{i,n}) - x_n)) + a_n - x_n), where μ_n ∈ ]0,2[, (a_n, b_{1,n}, …, b_{m,n}) ∈ H^{m+1}, and λ_n ∈ ]0,1].
Algorithm 6.11.chapter_id: 2004-Combettes-Monotone_Averaged.correction.md::6.3 Partial Yosida approximation of monotone inclusions

Corollary 6.12.name: Corollary 6.12
Corollary 6.12.content: Suppose that the following conditions are satisfied: (i) G ≠ ∅. (ii) lim̲ λ_n > 0 and 0 < lim̲ μ_n ≤ lim̄ μ_n < 2. (iii) ∑_{n∈N} ‖a_n‖ < +∞ and max_{1≤i≤m} ∑_{n∈N} ‖b_{i,n}‖ < +∞. Then every orbit of Algorithm 6.11 converges weakly to a point in G.
Corollary 6.12.proof_text: The claim is a consequence of Corollary 6.5 with A and B defined in (6.25)–(6.26) and (∀n∈N) b_n = -∑_{i=1}^m ω_i b_{i,n} / β and μ_n = γ_n / β.
Corollary 6.12.chapter_id: 2004-Combettes-Monotone_Averaged.correction.md::6.3 Partial Yosida approximation of monotone inclusions

推论 7.1.name: 推论 7.1
推论 7.1.content: 对于每个 $i \in \{1, \dots, m\}$，设 $T_i \in \mathcal{A}(\alpha_i)$，其中 $\alpha_i \in ]0, 1[$。固定 $x_0 \in \mathcal{H}$，并对每个 $n \in \mathbb{N}$，定义 $x_{n+1} = x_n + \lambda_n \left( T_1 \left( T_2 \left( \dots T_{m-1} (T_m x_n + e_{m,n}) + e_{m-1,n} \dots \right) + e_{2,n} \right) + e_{1,n} - x_n \right)$，其中 $(e_{i,n})_{1\leq i\leq m} \in \mathcal{H}^m$ 且 $\lambda_n \in ]0,1]$。假设以下条件满足：(i) Fix $T_1 \cdots T_m \neq \emptyset$；(ii) $\underline{\lim} \lambda_n > 0$；(iii) $(\forall i \in \{1,\dots,m\})$ $\sum_{n\in \mathbb{N}} \| e_{i,n}\| < +\infty$。则 $(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ 弱收敛到 Fix $T_1 \cdots T_m$ 中的一点 $y$。此外，$(T_1 \dots T_m x_n, T_2 \dots T_m x_n, \dots, T_m x_n) \rightharpoonup (T_1 \dots T_m y, T_2 \dots T_m y, \dots, T_m y)$。
推论 7.1.proof_text: 设 $T = T_1 \cdots T_m$，并设 $(x_{k_n})_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ 是一个子序列，使得 $x_{k_n} \rightharpoonup y$ 对某个 $y \in \mathcal{H}$ 成立。根据 (i)-(iii)、定理 3.2 和注记 3.4，只需证明 $(\forall x \in \operatorname{Fix} T) \max_{1 \leq j \leq m} \sum_{n \in \mathbb{N}} \| (\operatorname{Id} - T_j) T_{j+1} \dots T_m x_n - (\operatorname{Id} - T_j) T_{j+1} \dots T_m x \|^2 < +\infty$ 蕴含 $y \in \operatorname{Fix} T$ 即可建立第一个结论。首先，从 (3.22) 推导出 $T x_n - x_n \rightarrow 0$。因此，由于 $T$ 是非扩张的，根据非扩张算子的半闭原理 [14, Lemma 4]，得到 $y \in \operatorname{Fix} T$。从而 $x_n \rightharpoonup y \in \operatorname{Fix} T$。现在通过归纳法证明第二个结论。对于 $i=1$，(7.4) 给出 $T_i \cdots T_m x_n = (T x_n - x_n) + x_n \rightharpoonup y = T_i \cdots T_m y$。假设对某个 $i \in \{1,\dots,m-1\}$，有 $T_i \cdots T_m x_n \rightharpoonup T_i \cdots T_m y$。那么，由于 (7.3) 给出 $T_{i+1} \cdots T_m x_n - T_i \cdots T_m x_n \to T_{i+1} \cdots T_m y - T_i \cdots T_m y$，我们得出结论 $T_{i+1} \cdots T_m x_n \rightharpoonup T_{i+1} \cdots T_m y$。
